## File: src/1/chat-schema.md
`````markdown
  1: # Chat Schema with Content Support
  2: 
  3: ## Base Schema
  4: 
  5: ```typescript
  6: const BaseChatSchema = {
  7:   // Existing fields from current schema
  8:   layout: string().optional(),
  9:   title: string().optional(),
 10:   // ... other existing fields ...
 11: 
 12:   // New content handling fields
 13:   includeContent: boolean().default(true),
 14:   contentPrefix: string().default("Context:"),
 15:   contentMaxLength: number().default(2000)
 16: }
 17: ```
 18: 
 19: ## Prompt Assembly
 20: 
 21: The system combines prompts in this order:
 22: 
 23: 1. Base system prompt from `1.md` (if `addSystemPrompt: true`)
 24:    ```typescript
 25:    if (config.addSystemPrompt) {
 26:      prompts.push(loadPromptContent('src/1/1.md'));
 27:    }
 28:    ```
 29: 
 30: 2. Business context from `business.md` (if `addBusinessPrompt: true`)
 31:    ```typescript
 32:    if (config.addBusinessPrompt) {
 33:      prompts.push(loadPromptContent('src/1/business.md'));
 34:    }
 35:    ```
 36: 
 37: 3. Page-specific system prompt (if provided)
 38:    ```typescript
 39:    if (config.systemPrompt) {
 40:      prompts.push(config.systemPrompt);
 41:    }
 42:    ```
 43: 
 44: 4. Page content (if `includeContent: true`)
 45:    ```typescript
 46:    if (config.includeContent && config.content) {
 47:      prompts.push(
 48:        `${config.contentPrefix}\n${
 49:          truncate(config.content, config.contentMaxLength)
 50:        }`
 51:      );
 52:    }
 53:    ```
 54: 
 55: ## Content Handling
 56: 
 57: Content is processed before being added to the prompt:
 58: 
 59: ```typescript
 60: function processContent(content: string, maxLength: number): string {
 61:   // Remove frontmatter
 62:   const cleanContent = content.replace(/^---[\s\S]*?---/, '');
 63:   
 64:   // Clean and normalize
 65:   const normalized = cleanContent
 66:     .trim()
 67:     .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
 68:     
 69:   // Truncate if needed
 70:   return truncate(normalized, maxLength);
 71: }
 72: ```
 73: 
 74: ## Example Usage
 75: 
 76: ```yaml
 77: ---
 78: layout: ../layouts/Text.astro
 79: title: Documentation Page
 80: includeContent: true
 81: contentPrefix: "Page Content:"
 82: contentMaxLength: 1500
 83: systemPrompt: "Answer questions about this documentation..."
 84: ---
 85: 
 86: # Page Content
 87: 
 88: This content will be included in the system prompt...
 89: ```
 90: 
 91: ## Benefits
 92: 
 93: 1. **Context Awareness**
 94:    - AI has access to page content
 95:    - Can reference specific details
 96:    - More accurate responses
 97: 
 98: 2. **Configurability**
 99:    - Enable/disable per page
100:    - Custom prefix
101:    - Length control
102: 
103: 3. **Performance**
104:    - Content truncation prevents token limits
105:    - Clean content processing
106:    - Efficient prompt assembly
`````

## File: src/1/content-guide.md
`````markdown
  1: # Content-Aware Chat System Guide
  2: 
  3: ## Overview
  4: 
  5: The content-aware chat system allows the AI to understand and reference page-specific content while maintaining its general knowledge capabilities. This creates a more contextual and accurate chat experience.
  6: 
  7: ## Implementation Approaches
  8: 
  9: ### 1. Basic Content Inclusion
 10: 
 11: ```yaml
 12: ---
 13: layout: ../layouts/Text.astro
 14: title: Simple Page
 15: includeContent: true
 16: systemPrompt: "Reference the content when answering questions."
 17: ---
 18: 
 19: Your page content here...
 20: ```
 21: 
 22: ### 2. Documentation Assistant
 23: 
 24: ```yaml
 25: ---
 26: layout: ../layouts/Text.astro
 27: title: API Documentation
 28: includeContent: true
 29: contentPrefix: "### API Documentation:"
 30: systemPrompt: "You are a technical documentation expert. Explain concepts from the documentation clearly and accurately."
 31: suggestions:
 32:   - "What are the key endpoints?"
 33:   - "How do I authenticate?"
 34:   - "Show me example usage"
 35: ---
 36: 
 37: API documentation content...
 38: ```
 39: 
 40: ### 3. Learning Assistant
 41: 
 42: ```yaml
 43: ---
 44: layout: ../layouts/Text.astro
 45: title: Tutorial
 46: includeContent: true
 47: contentPrefix: "### Tutorial Content:"
 48: systemPrompt: "You are a patient teacher. Help users understand concepts from the tutorial. Provide examples and explanations based on the tutorial content."
 49: suggestions:
 50:   - "Explain this concept"
 51:   - "Show me an example"
 52:   - "What's next?"
 53: ---
 54: 
 55: Tutorial content...
 56: ```
 57: 
 58: ## Content Processing
 59: 
 60: The system automatically:
 61: 1. Strips frontmatter
 62: 2. Cleans formatting
 63: 3. Truncates if needed
 64: 4. Adds to system prompt
 65: 
 66: ## Best Practices
 67: 
 68: ### Content Structure
 69: - Use clear headings
 70: - Keep sections focused
 71: - Include important details
 72: - Use consistent formatting
 73: 
 74: ### Configuration
 75: - Set appropriate content length limits
 76: - Customize prefix for content type
 77: - Craft specific system prompts
 78: - Add relevant suggestions
 79: 
 80: ### System Prompt Design
 81: - Tell AI to reference content
 82: - Define its role clearly
 83: - Specify how to handle missing info
 84: - Include citation instructions
 85: 
 86: ## Common Patterns
 87: 
 88: 1. **Documentation Helper**
 89:    ```yaml
 90:    systemPrompt: "Explain documentation concepts. Always cite sections."
 91:    ```
 92: 
 93: 2. **Tutorial Guide**
 94:    ```yaml
 95:    systemPrompt: "Walk through concepts step by step using tutorial content."
 96:    ```
 97: 
 98: 3. **Content Summarizer**
 99:    ```yaml
100:    systemPrompt: "Summarize and explain key points from the content."
101:    ```
102: 
103: ## Advanced Usage
104: 
105: ### Combining Knowledge Sources
106: 
107: ```yaml
108: addSystemPrompt: true      # Include core knowledge
109: addBusinessPrompt: true    # Include business context
110: includeContent: true       # Include page content
111: ```
112: 
113: ### Content Processing Control
114: 
115: ```yaml
116: contentMaxLength: 2000     # Limit content length
117: contentPrefix: "custom:"   # Custom prefix
118: ```
119: 
120: ### Response Styling
121: 
122: ```yaml
123: systemPrompt: |
124:   When answering:
125:   1. Quote relevant sections
126:   2. Provide examples
127:   3. Link related concepts
128: ```
129: 
130: ## Benefits
131: 
132: 1. **Accuracy**
133:    - Responses based on actual content
134:    - Verifiable references
135:    - Clear source attribution
136: 
137: 2. **Flexibility**
138:    - Works with any content type
139:    - Customizable per page
140:    - Adaptable to different uses
141: 
142: 3. **User Experience**
143:    - Contextual responses
144:    - Relevant suggestions
145:    - Immediate access to content
146: 
147: 4. **Maintenance**
148:    - Content updates automatically reflected
149:    - No manual syncing needed
150:    - Easy to modify behavior
`````

`````markdown
 1: # Content Handling in Chat System
 2: 
 3: ## Current Structure in ai.md
 4: ```yaml
 5: ---
 6: layout: ../layouts/Text.astro
 7: title: ONE License
 8: # ... other frontmatter ...
 9: ---
10: # This is some contnet
11: the secret is xoxoxo
12: ```
13: 
14: ## Required Changes in schema/chat.ts
15: 
16: 1. **Content Inclusion**
17: ```typescript
18: function combinePrompts(config: BaseChat, content?: string): ContentPart[] {
19:   const prompts: string[] = [];
20: 
21:   // Add base prompts
22:   if (config.addSystemPrompt) {
23:     const systemPrompt = loadPromptContent('src/1/1.md');
24:     if (systemPrompt) prompts.push(systemPrompt);
25:   }
26: 
27:   if (config.addBusinessPrompt) {
28:     const businessPrompt = loadPromptContent('src/1/business.md');
29:     if (businessPrompt) prompts.push(businessPrompt);
30:   }
31: 
32:   // Add page specific prompt
33:   if (config.systemPrompt) {
34:     prompts.push(typeof config.systemPrompt === 'string' 
35:       ? config.systemPrompt 
36:       : config.systemPrompt.map(p => p.text).join('\n\n')
37:     );
38:   }
39: 
40:   // Add page content
41:   if (content) {
42:     prompts.push(`Page Content:\n${content}`);
43:   }
44: 
45:   return prompts.map(text => ({
46:     type: 'text' as const,
47:     text: text.trim()
48:   }));
49: }
`````

`````markdown
 1: # Content Prompt System
 2: 
 3: ## Overview
 4: 
 5: A simple system to include page content in chat system prompts.
 6: 
 7: ## Implementation Plan
 8: 
 9: 1. **Content Extraction**
10:    - Get raw content from markdown file
11:    - Strip frontmatter
12:    - Clean any special characters/formatting
13: 
14: 2. **Configuration Options**
15:    ```yaml
16:    includeContent: true            # Enable/disable content inclusion
17:    contentPrefix: "Context:"       # Prefix for content section
18:    contentMaxLength: 2000         # Maximum content length
19:    ```
20: 
21: 3. **Prompt Assembly Order**
22:    1. System prompt (if addSystemPrompt: true)
23:    2. Business prompt (if addBusinessPrompt: true)
24:    3. Page specific prompt (if systemPrompt exists)
25:    4. Content section (if includeContent: true)
26:       ```
27:       Context:
28:       [Cleaned page content here]
29:       ```
30: 
31: 4. **Usage in Frontmatter**
32:    ```yaml
33:    ---
34:    layout: ../layouts/Text.astro
35:    title: Some Page
36:    description: Description
37:    includeContent: true
38:    contentPrefix: "Reference Material:"
39:    systemPrompt: "You are a helpful assistant..."
40:    ---
41:    ```
42: 
43: ## Components to Update
44: 
45: 1. `src/schema/chat.ts`
46:    - Add content handling options to schema
47:    - Update prompt assembly logic
48: 
49: 2. `src/layouts/Text.astro`
50:    - Pass cleaned content to chat component
51:    - Handle content truncation
52: 
53: 3. `src/components/Chat.tsx`
54:    - Use assembled prompt including content
55:    - Handle content updates
56: 
57: ## Benefits
58: - Simple opt-in content inclusion
59: - Configurable per page
60: - Clear separation of concerns
61: - Easy to extend
`````

 9: }
10: 
11: const JsxRenderer = React.forwardRef<JsxParser, JsxRendererProps>(
12: 	({ className, jsx, fixIncompleteJsx = true, components }, ref) => {
13: 		const processedJsx = React.useMemo(() => {
14: 			return fixIncompleteJsx ? completeJsxTag(jsx) : jsx;
15: 		}, [jsx, fixIncompleteJsx]);
16: 
17: 		return (
18: 			<JsxParser
19: 				ref={ref}
20: 				className={className}
21: 				jsx={processedJsx}
22: 				components={components}
23: 			/>
24: 		);
25: 	},
26: );
27: JsxRenderer.displayName = "JsxRenderer";
28: 
29: export { JsxRenderer };
`````

 12: const extractTextContent = (node: React.ReactNode): string => {
 13:   type ReactElementWithChildren = React.ReactElement & {
 14:     props: { children?: React.ReactNode }

 16: 	if (typeof node === "string") {
 17: 		return node;

 20: 		return node.map(extractTextContent).join("");
 21: 	}
 22: 	if (isValidElement(node)) {
 23: 	  const element = node as ReactElementWithChildren;
 24: 	  return extractTextContent(element.props.children || '');
 25: 	}
 26: 	return "";

318: function parseMarkdownIntoBlocks(markdown: string): string[] {
319: 	if (!markdown) {
320: 		return [];
321: 	}
322: 	const tokens = marked.lexer(markdown);
323: 	return tokens.map((token) => token.raw);
324: }

327: 	content: string;
328: 	className?: string;

330: 
331: const MemoizedMarkdownBlock = memo(
332: 	({ content, className }: MarkdownBlockProps) => {
333: 		return (
334: 		  <div className={className}>
335: 		    <ReactMarkdown
336: 		      remarkPlugins={[remarkGfm]}
337: 		      components={components}
338: 		    >
339: 		      {content}
340: 		    </ReactMarkdown>
341: 		  </div>
342: 		);
343: 	},
344: 	(prevProps, nextProps) => {
345: 		if (prevProps.content !== nextProps.content) {
346: 			return false;
347: 		}
348: 		return true;
349: 	},
350: );
351: 
352: MemoizedMarkdownBlock.displayName = "MemoizedMarkdownBlock";
353: 
354: interface MarkdownContentProps {
355: 	content: string;
356: 	id: string;
357: 	className?: string;
358: }
359: 
360: export const MarkdownContent = memo(
361: 	({ content, id, className }: MarkdownContentProps) => {
362: 		const blocks = useMemo(
363: 			() => parseMarkdownIntoBlocks(content || ""),
364: 			[content],
365: 		);
366: 
367: 		return blocks.map((block, index) => (
368: 			<MemoizedMarkdownBlock
369: 				content={block}
370: 				className={className}
371: 				key={`${id}-block_${
372: 					// biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noArrayIndexKey: <explanation>
373: 					index
374: 				}`}
375: 			/>
376: 		));
377: 	},
378: );
379: 
380: MarkdownContent.displayName = "MarkdownContent";

 7:   interface Window {
 8:     TagCanvas: {
 9:       Start: (id: string, parentId: string, options: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
10:       Delete: (id: string) => void;
11:     };
12:   }
13: }
14: 
15: interface CloudProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
16:   children: React.ReactNode[];
17:   canvasProps?: HTMLAttributes<HTMLCanvasElement>;
18:   options?: Record<string, unknown>;
19:   dragControl?: boolean;
20: }
21: 
22: export function Cloud({
23:   children,
24:   canvasProps,
25:   options = {},
26:   dragControl = false,
27:   ...props
28: }: CloudProps) {
29:   const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
30:   const id = useId();
31: 
32:   useEffect(() => {
33:     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
34:     if (!canvas) return;
35: 
36:     try {
37:       window.TagCanvas.Start(canvas.id, `tags-${id}`, {
38:         dragControl,
39:         textColour: null,
40:         dragThreshold: 4,
41:         initial: [0.1, -0.1],
42:         maxSpeed: 0.04,
43:         minSpeed: 0.02,
44:         decel: 0.95,
45:         reverse: true,
46:         ...options,
47:       });
48:     } catch (error) {
49:       console.error("Error initializing TagCanvas:", error);
50:     }
51: 
52:     return () => {
53:       try {
54:         window.TagCanvas.Delete(canvas.id);
55:       } catch (error) {
56:         console.error("Error cleaning up TagCanvas:", error);
57:       }
58:     };
59:   }, [dragControl, id, options]);
60: 
61:   return (
62:     <div {...props}>
63:       <canvas
64:         id={`canvas-${id}`}
65:         ref={canvasRef}
66:         width={600}
67:         height={600}
68:         {...canvasProps}
69:       />
70:       <div id={`tags-${id}`} className="hidden">
71:         {children}
72:       </div>
73:     </div>

 9: export async function fetchSimpleIcons(slugs: string[]): Promise<Icon[]> {

## File: src/components/magicui/icon-cloud.tsx
`````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: 
 3: import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
 4: import { Icon } from "@iconify/react";
 5: 
 6: interface IconCloudProps {
 7:   iconSlugs: string[];
 8: }
 9: 
10: export default function IconCloud({ iconSlugs }: IconCloudProps) {
11:   const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);
12:   const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
13: 
14:   useEffect(() => {
15:     if (!containerRef.current) return;
16:     setIsLoaded(true);
17: 
18:     const icons = containerRef.current.getElementsByClassName("icon-item");
19:     Array.from(icons).forEach((icon, index) => {
20: 
21:       const phi = Math.acos(-1 + (2 * index) / icons.length);
22:       const theta = Math.sqrt(icons.length * Math.PI) * phi;
23: 
24: 
25:       const radius = Math.min(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight) * 0.4;
26:       const x = Math.cos(theta) * Math.sin(phi);
27:       const y = Math.sin(theta) * Math.sin(phi);
28:       const z = Math.cos(phi);
29: 
30: 
31:       const el = icon as HTMLElement;
32:       el.style.setProperty("--x", `${x * radius}px`);
33:       el.style.setProperty("--y", `${y * radius}px`);
34:       el.style.setProperty("--z", `${z * radius}px`);
35:       el.style.setProperty("--delay", `${index * 100}ms`);
36:     });
37:   }, []);
38: 
39:   return (
40:     <div
41:       ref={containerRef}
42:       className={`fixed inset-0 transition-opacity duration-1000 ${
43:         isLoaded ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
44:       }`}
45:     >
46:       <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin-slow">
47:         {iconSlugs.map((slug) => (
48:           <div
49:             key={slug}
50:             className="icon-item absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2"
51:             style={{
52:               animation: "orbit 30s linear infinite",
53:               animationDelay: `var(--delay)`,
54:               transform: "translate3d(var(--x), var(--y), var(--z))",
55:             }}
56:           >
57:             <Icon
58:               icon={slug}
59:               className="h-8 w-8 md:h-12 md:w-12 transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-150"
60:               style={{
61:                 filter: "drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(var(--primary-rgb), 0.3))",
62:               }}
63:             />
64:           </div>
65:         ))}
66:       </div>
67:     </div>
68:   );
69: }
`````

## File: src/components/magicui/render-simple-icon.tsx
`````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: 
 3: import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";
 4: import { getContrastRatio, hexToRgb } from "./utils";
 5: 
 6: export interface Icon {
 7:   title: string;
 8:   slug: string;
 9:   svg: string;
10:   hex: string;
11:   source: string;
12: }
13: 
14: interface RenderSimpleIconProps {
15:   icon: Icon;
16:   bgHex?: string;
17:   fallbackHex?: string;
18:   minContrastRatio?: number;
19:   size?: number;
20:   aProps?: HTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>;
21:   imgProps?: HTMLAttributes<HTMLImageElement>;
22: }
23: 
24: export function renderSimpleIcon({
25:   icon,
26:   bgHex = "#fff",
27:   fallbackHex = "#000",
28:   minContrastRatio = 1,
29:   size = 42,
30:   aProps,
31:   imgProps,
32: }: RenderSimpleIconProps) {
33:   const iconColor = `#${icon.hex}`;
34:   const iconRgb = hexToRgb(iconColor);
35:   if (!iconRgb) {
36:     return fallbackHex;
37:   }
38: 
39:   const bgRgb = hexToRgb(bgHex);
40:   if (!bgRgb) {
41:     return fallbackHex;
42:   }
43: 
44:   const contrast = getContrastRatio(iconRgb, bgRgb);
45:   const color = contrast >= minContrastRatio ? iconColor : fallbackHex;
46: 
47:   return (
48:     <a
49:       key={icon.slug}
50:       href={icon.source}
51:       target="_blank"
52:       rel="noopener noreferrer"
53:       {...aProps}
54:     >
55:       <img
56:         src={`data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(
57:           icon.svg.replace(/currentColor/g, color)
58:         )}`}

## File: src/components/magicui/utils.ts
`````typescript
 1: export interface RGB {
 2:   r: number;
 3:   g: number;
 4:   b: number;
 5: }
 6: 
 7: export function hexToRgb(hex: string): RGB | null {
 8:   const result = /^#?([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})([a-f\d]{2})$/i.exec(hex);
 9:   if (!result) return null;
10: 
11:   return {
12:     r: parseInt(result[1] || '0', 16),
13:     g: parseInt(result[2] || '0', 16),
14:     b: parseInt(result[3] || '0', 16),
15:   };
16: }
17: 
18: export function getLuminance({ r, g, b }: RGB): number {
19:   const rs = r / 255;
20:   const gs = g / 255;
21:   const bs = b / 255;
22: 
23:   return 0.2126 * rs + 0.7152 * gs + 0.0722 * bs;
24: }
25: 
26: export function getContrastRatio(foreground: RGB, background: RGB): number {
27:   const l1 = getLuminance(foreground) + 0.05;
28:   const l2 = getLuminance(background) + 0.05;
29:   return Math.max(l1, l2) / Math.min(l1, l2);
30: }
`````

306: function getPayloadConfigFromPayload(

324:   if (
325:     key in payload &&

327:   ) {

329:   } else if (

336:     ] as string
337:   }
338: 
339:   return configLabelKey in config
340:     ? config[configLabelKey]
341:     : config[key as keyof typeof config]
342: }

 32:   TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
 33: >({
 34:   ...props
 35: }: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
 36:   return (
 37:     <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>

 40:   )

 42: 
 43: const useFormField = () => {

 45:   const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext)
 46:   const { getFieldState } = useFormContext()
 47:   const formState = useFormState({ name: fieldContext.name })

101:     />

25: export function useLocation() {
26:   const [pathname, setPathname] = React.useState("/");
27: 
28:   React.useEffect(() => {
29:     setPathname(window.location.pathname);
30: 
31:     const handleRouteChange = () => {
32:       setPathname(window.location.pathname);
33:     };
34: 
35:     window.addEventListener('popstate', handleRouteChange);
36:     document.addEventListener('astro:page-load', handleRouteChange);
37: 
38:     return () => {
39:       window.removeEventListener('popstate', handleRouteChange);
40:       document.removeEventListener('astro:page-load', handleRouteChange);
41:     };
42:   }, []);
43: 
44:   return { pathname };
45: }

 33:   const pulsePhase = useRef<number>(0)
 34:   const [hoveredSquare, setHoveredSquare] = useState<{
 35:     x: number
 36:     y: number
 37:   } | null>(null)
 38: 
 39:   useEffect(() => {
 40:     const canvas = canvasRef.current
 41:     if (!canvas) return
 42: 
 43:     const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d")
 44:     if (!ctx) return
 45: 
 46:     canvas.style.background = "transparent"
 47: 
 48:     const resizeCanvas = () => {
 49:       const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1
 50:       canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth * dpr
 51:       canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight * dpr
 52:       ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
 53:       canvas.style.width = `${canvas.offsetWidth}px`
 54:       canvas.style.height = `${canvas.offsetHeight}px`
 55:       numSquaresX.current = Math.ceil(canvas.width / squareSize) + 1
 56:       numSquaresY.current = Math.ceil(canvas.height / squareSize) + 1
 57:     }
 58: 
 59:     window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas)
 60:     resizeCanvas()
 61: 
 62:     const drawGrid = () => {
 63:       ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
 64: 
 65:       const startX = Math.floor(gridOffset.current.x / squareSize) * squareSize
 66:       const startY = Math.floor(gridOffset.current.y / squareSize) * squareSize
 67: 
 68:       if (pulseEffect) {
 69:         pulsePhase.current = (pulsePhase.current + 0.02) % (Math.PI * 2)
 70:       }
 71: 
 72:       for (let x = startX; x < canvas.width + squareSize; x += squareSize) {
 73:         for (let y = startY; y < canvas.height + squareSize; y += squareSize) {
 74:           const squareX = x - (gridOffset.current.x % squareSize)
 75:           const squareY = y - (gridOffset.current.y % squareSize)
 76: 
 77:           const centerX = canvas.width / 2
 78:           const centerY = canvas.height / 2
 79:           const distanceFromCenter = Math.sqrt(
 80:             Math.pow((squareX - centerX) / centerX, 2) +
 81:             Math.pow((squareY - centerY) / centerY, 2)
 82:           )
 83: 
 84:           let opacity = pulseEffect
 85:             ? 0.5 + 0.3 * Math.sin(pulsePhase.current + distanceFromCenter * 2)
 86:             : 0.7
 87:           opacity *= Math.max(0.3, 1 - distanceFromCenter)
 88: 
 89:           if (
 90:             hoveredSquare &&
 91:             Math.floor((x - startX) / squareSize) === hoveredSquare.x &&
 92:             Math.floor((y - startY) / squareSize) === hoveredSquare.y
 93:           ) {
 94:             ctx.fillStyle = hoverFillColor
 95:             ctx.fillRect(squareX, squareY, squareSize, squareSize)
 96: 
 97:             ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)"
 98:             ctx.shadowBlur = 20 * glowIntensity
 99:           } else {
100:             ctx.shadowColor = "transparent"
101:             ctx.shadowBlur = 0
102:           }
103: 
104:           ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${opacity})`
105:           ctx.lineWidth = 1
106:           ctx.strokeRect(squareX, squareY, squareSize, squareSize)
107:         }
108:       }
109: 
110:       if (fadeEdges) {
111:         const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
112:           canvas.width / 2,
113:           canvas.height / 2,
114:           0,
115:           canvas.width / 2,
116:           canvas.height / 2,
117:           Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 1.5
118:         )
119:         gradient.addColorStop(0, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)")
120:         gradient.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7)")
121: 
122:         ctx.fillStyle = gradient
123:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
124:       }
125:     }
126: 
127:     const updateAnimation = () => {
128:       const effectiveSpeed = Math.max(speed, 0.1)
129:       const time = Date.now() * 0.001
130: 
131:       const waveOffset = Math.sin(time) * 0.5
132: 
133:       switch (direction) {
134:         case "right":
135:           gridOffset.current.x =
136:             (gridOffset.current.x - effectiveSpeed + waveOffset + squareSize) % squareSize
137:           break
138:         case "left":
139:           gridOffset.current.x =
140:             (gridOffset.current.x + effectiveSpeed + waveOffset + squareSize) % squareSize
141:           break
142:         case "up":
143:           gridOffset.current.y =
144:             (gridOffset.current.y + effectiveSpeed + waveOffset + squareSize) % squareSize
145:           break
146:         case "down":
147:           gridOffset.current.y =
148:             (gridOffset.current.y - effectiveSpeed + waveOffset + squareSize) % squareSize
149:           break
150:         case "diagonal":
151:           gridOffset.current.x =
152:             (gridOffset.current.x - effectiveSpeed + waveOffset + squareSize) % squareSize
153:           gridOffset.current.y =
154:             (gridOffset.current.y - effectiveSpeed + waveOffset + squareSize) % squareSize
155:           break
156:       }
157: 
158:       drawGrid()
159:       requestRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(updateAnimation)
160:     }
161: 
162:     const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
163:       const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect()
164:       const mouseX = event.clientX - rect.left
165:       const mouseY = event.clientY - rect.top
166: 
167:       const startX = Math.floor(gridOffset.current.x / squareSize) * squareSize
168:       const startY = Math.floor(gridOffset.current.y / squareSize) * squareSize
169: 
170:       const hoveredSquareX = Math.floor(
171:         (mouseX + gridOffset.current.x - startX) / squareSize,
172:       )
173:       const hoveredSquareY = Math.floor(
174:         (mouseY + gridOffset.current.y - startY) / squareSize,
175:       )
176: 
177:       setHoveredSquare({ x: hoveredSquareX, y: hoveredSquareY })
178:     }
179: 
180:     const handleMouseLeave = () => {
181:       setHoveredSquare(null)
182:     }
183: 
184:     window.addEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas)
185:     canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", handleMouseMove)
186:     canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", handleMouseLeave)
187: 
188:     resizeCanvas()
189:     requestRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(updateAnimation)
190: 
191:     return () => {
192:       window.removeEventListener("resize", resizeCanvas)
193:       canvas.removeEventListener("mousemove", handleMouseMove)
194:       canvas.removeEventListener("mouseleave", handleMouseLeave)
195:       if (requestRef.current) {
196:         cancelAnimationFrame(requestRef.current)
197:       }
198:     }
199:   }, [direction, speed, borderColor, hoverFillColor, hoveredSquare, squareSize, glowIntensity, fadeEdges, pulseEffect])
200: 
201:   return (
202:     <canvas
203:       ref={canvasRef}
204:       style={{ height: typeof height === 'number' ? `${height}px` : height }}
205:       className={`w-full border-none block bg-transparent ${className}`}
206:     />
207:   )
208: }
`````

## File: src/components/ChartClones.tsx
`````typescript
  1: "use client"
  2: 
  3: import * as React from "react"
  4: import { Bar, BarChart, CartesianGrid, XAxis } from "recharts"
  5: 
  6: import {
  7:     Card,
  8:     CardContent,
  9:     CardDescription,
 10:     CardHeader,
 11:     CardTitle,
 12: } from "@/components/ui/card"
 13: import type {
 14:     ChartConfig,
 15: } from "@/components/ui/chart"
 16: import {
 17:     ChartContainer,
 18:     ChartTooltip,
 19:     ChartTooltipContent,
 20: } from "@/components/ui/chart"
 21: 
 22: const chartConfig = {
 23:     views: {
 24:         label: "Repository Clones",
 25:     },
 26:     total: {
 27:         label: "Total Clones",
 28:         color: "hsl(220, 100%, 50%)",
 29:     },
 30:     uniques: {
 31:         label: "Unique Cloners",
 32:         color: "hsl(220, 70%, 60%)",
 33:     },
 34: } satisfies ChartConfig
 35: 
 36: interface CloneData {
 37:     timestamp: string;
 38:     total: number;
 39:     uniques: number;
 40: }
 41: 
 42: 
 43: const tooltipStyle = {
 44:     backgroundColor: "hsl(var(--card))",
 45:     border: "1px solid hsl(var(--border))",
 46:     borderRadius: "var(--radius)",
 47:     color: "hsl(var(--foreground))",
 48:     boxShadow: "0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)",
 49: };
 50: 
 51: export function Chart() {
 52:     const [chartData, setChartData] = React.useState<CloneData[]>([]);
 53:     const [activeChart, setActiveChart] = React.useState<keyof typeof chartConfig>("total");
 54: 
 55:     const total = React.useMemo(
 56:         () => ({
 57:             total: chartData.reduce((acc: number, curr: CloneData) => acc + curr.total, 0),
 58:             uniques: chartData.reduce((acc: number, curr: CloneData) => acc + curr.uniques, 0),
 59:         }),
 60:         [chartData]
 61:     )
 62: 
 63:     React.useEffect(() => {
 64:         const fetchCloneData = async () => {
 65:             try {
 66: 
 67:                 const response = await fetch('/api/github');
 68: 
 69:                 if (!response.ok) {
 70:                     console.error(`API responded with status ${response.status}`);
 71:                     setChartData([]);
 72:                     return;
 73:                 }
 74: 
 75:                 const data = await response.json();
 76: 
 77:                 if (data && Array.isArray(data.clones)) {
 78:                     const sortedClones = data.clones
 79:                         .sort((a: { timestamp: string }, b: { timestamp: string }) =>
 80:                             new Date(a.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(b.timestamp).getTime())
 81:                         .map((clone: { timestamp: string; count: number; uniques: number }) => ({
 82:                             timestamp: clone.timestamp,
 83:                             total: clone.count,
 84:                             uniques: clone.uniques
 85:                         }));
 86:                     setChartData(sortedClones);
 87:                 } else {
 88:                     console.error('Invalid response format from API');
 89:                     setChartData([]);
 90:                 }
 91:             } catch (error) {
 92:                 console.error('Error fetching clone data:', error);
 93:                 setChartData([]);
 94:             }
 95:         };
 96: 
 97:         fetchCloneData();
 98:         const interval = setInterval(fetchCloneData, 5 * 60 * 1000);
 99:         return () => clearInterval(interval);
100:     }, []);
101: 
102:     return (
103:         <Card>
104:             <CardHeader className="flex flex-col items-stretch space-y-0 border-b p-0 sm:flex-row">
105:                 <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-1 px-6 py-5 sm:py-6">
106:                     <CardTitle>GitHub Clone Statistics</CardTitle>
107:                     <CardDescription>
108:                         Repository clone activity over the last 15 days
109:                     </CardDescription>
110:                 </div>
111:                 <div className="flex">
112:                     {["total", "uniques"].map((key) => {
113:                         const chart = key as keyof typeof chartConfig
114:                         return (
115:                             <button
116:                                 key={chart}
117:                                 data-active={activeChart === chart}
118:                                 className="relative z-30 flex flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-1 border-t px-6 py-4 text-left even:border-l data-[active=true]:bg-muted/50 sm:border-l sm:border-t-0 sm:px-8 sm:py-6"
119:                                 onClick={() => setActiveChart(chart)}
120:                             >
121:                                 <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
122:                                     {chartConfig[chart].label}
123:                                 </span>
124:                                 <span className="text-lg font-bold leading-none sm:text-3xl">
125:                                     {total[key as keyof typeof total]?.toLocaleString() || '0'}
126:                                 </span>
127:                             </button>
128:                         )
129:                     })}
130:                 </div>
131:             </CardHeader>
132:             <CardContent className="px-2 sm:p-6">
133:                 <ChartContainer
134:                     config={chartConfig}
135:                     className="aspect-auto h-[250px] w-full"
136:                 >
137:                     <BarChart
138:                         accessibilityLayer
139:                         data={chartData}
140:                         margin={{
141:                             left: 12,
142:                             right: 12,
143:                         }}
144:                     >

146:                         <XAxis

148:                             tickLine={false}
149:                             axisLine={false}

151:                             minTickGap={24}

153:                                 const date = new Date(value)
154:                                 return date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
155:                                     month: "short",
156:                                     day: "numeric"
157:                                 })
158:                             }}
159:                         />

162:                             contentStyle={tooltipStyle}
163:                             content={
164:                                 <ChartTooltipContent
165:                                     className="w-[150px] bg-card text-card-foreground border-border"
166:                                     nameKey="views"
167:                                     labelFormatter={(value) => {
168:                                         return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
169:                                             month: "short",
170:                                             day: "numeric",
171:                                             year: "numeric",
172:                                         })
173:                                     }}
174:                                 />
175:                             }
176:                         />

182:                             animationDuration={500}
183:                         />
184:                     </BarChart>

189: }

## File: src/components/CopyButton.tsx
`````typescript
 1: import * as React from 'react'
 2: import { Check, Copy } from 'lucide-react'
 3: 
 4: type CopyButtonProps = {
 5: content: string
 6: className?: string
 7: label?: string
 8: }
 9: 
10: export default function CopyButton({ content, className = "", label = "Copy" }: CopyButtonProps) {
11: const [copied, setCopied] = React.useState(false)
12: 
13: const handleCopy = async () => {
14: try {
15: await navigator.clipboard.writeText(content)
16: setCopied(true)
17: setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000)
18: } catch (err) {
19: console.error('Failed to copy:', err)
20: }
21: }
22: 
23: return (
24: <button
25: onClick={handleCopy}
26: className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg p-2 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 ${className}`}
27: title={label}
28: >
29: {copied ? (
30:   <Check className="h-4 w-4" />
31: ) : (
32:   <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />
33: )}
34: </button>
35: )
36: }
`````

 82:         const response = await fetch('https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana&vs_currencies=usd');
 83:         const data = await response.json();
 84: 
 85:         const newPrices: CryptoPrices = {
 86:           BTC: data.bitcoin.usd,
 87:           ETH: data.ethereum.usd,
 88:           SOL: data.solana.usd
 89:         };
 90: 
 91:         setPrices(newPrices);
 92:         const cryptoPrice = newPrices[selectedCrypto];
 93:         setCryptoAmount((amount / cryptoPrice).toFixed(8));
 94:       } catch (err) {
 95:         setError("Failed to fetch crypto prices. Please try again.");
 96:         console.error('Price fetch error:', err);
 97:       }
 98:     };
 99: 
100:     getCryptoPrices();
101:     // Set up polling for price updates every 30 seconds
102:     const interval = setInterval(getCryptoPrices, 30000);
103: 
104:     return () => clearInterval(interval);
105:   }, [selectedCrypto, amount]);
106: 
107:   const handleCopy = (text: string) => {
108:     navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
109:     toast("Copied to clipboard", {
110:       description: "Address copied to clipboard",
111:       duration: 3000
112:     });
113:   };
114: 
115:   const handleSubmit = async () => {
116:     if (!senderAddress) {
117:       toast("Error", {
118:         description: "Please enter your sender address",
119:         duration: 3000
120:       });
121:       return;
122:     }
123:     setStatus("verifying");
124:     try {
125:       await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
126:       setStatus("completed");
127:       toast("Success", {
128:         description: "Payment verified successfully!",
129:         duration: 3000
130:       });
131: 
132:       if (onSuccess) {
133:         onSuccess({
134:           hash: `${selectedCrypto}_${Date.now()}`,
135:           confirmations: 1,
136:           amount: cryptoAmount,
137:           currency: selectedCrypto,
138:           senderAddress
139:         });
140:       }
141:     } catch (err) {
142:       setStatus("failed");
143:       setError("Failed to verify payment. Please try again or contact support.");
144:       toast("Error", {
145:         description: "Payment verification failed",
146:         duration: 3000
147:       });
148:     }
149:   };
150: 
151:   return (
152:     <div className="w-full">
153:       <Select
154:         value={selectedCrypto}
155:         onValueChange={(value: CryptoCurrency) => setSelectedCrypto(value)}
156:       >
157:         <SelectTrigger className="w-full mb-4">
158:           <SelectValue placeholder="Select cryptocurrency" />
159:         </SelectTrigger>
160:         <SelectContent>
161:           {Object.entries(CRYPTO_CONFIG).map(([key, config]) => (
162:             <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
163:               <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
164:                 <img src={config.icon} alt={key} className="w-5 h-5" />
165:                 {key}
166:               </div>
167:             </SelectItem>
168:           ))}
169:         </SelectContent>
170:       </Select>
171: 
172:       {prices && (
173:         <div className="mb-6 p-4 border rounded-lg">
174:           <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
175:             <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Amount Due:</span>
176:             <span className="font-bold">${amount} {currency}</span>
177:           </div>
178:           <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
179:             <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Crypto Amount:</span>
180:             <span className="font-bold">{cryptoAmount} {selectedCrypto}</span>
181:           </div>
182:         </div>
183:       )}
184: 
185:       <div className="text-center mb-6">
186:         {showQR ? (
187:           <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-lg inline-block">
188:             <QRCode
189:               value={`${CRYPTO_CONFIG[selectedCrypto].qrPrefix}${CRYPTO_CONFIG[selectedCrypto].address}?amount=${cryptoAmount}`}
190:               size={200}
191:             />
192:           </div>
193:         ) : (
194:           <Button
195:             variant="outline"
196:             onClick={() => setShowQR(true)}
197:             className="w-full"
198:           >
199:             <QrCode className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
200:             Show QR Code
201:           </Button>
202:         )}
203:       </div>
204: 
205:       <div className="space-y-4">
206:         <div>
207:           <Label>Recipient Address</Label>
208:           <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
209:             <Input
210:               value={CRYPTO_CONFIG[selectedCrypto].address}
211:               readOnly
212:             />
213:             <Button
214:               variant="outline"
215:               size="icon"
216:               onClick={() => handleCopy(CRYPTO_CONFIG[selectedCrypto].address)}
217:             >
218:               <Copy className="w-4 h-4" />
219:             </Button>
220:           </div>
221:         </div>
222: 
223:         <div>
224:           <Label>Your {selectedCrypto} Address</Label>
225:           <Input
226:             value={senderAddress}
227:             onChange={(e) => setSenderAddress(e.target.value)}
228:             placeholder={`Enter your ${selectedCrypto} address`}
229:           />
230:         </div>
231: 
232:         <Button
233:           className="w-full"
234:           onClick={handleSubmit}
235:           disabled={!senderAddress || status === "verifying"}
236:         >
237:           {status === "verifying" ? "Verifying Payment..." : "Verify Payment"}
238:         </Button>
239:

242:             <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4" />
243:             {error}
244:           </div>

247:     </div>

249: }

## File: src/components/ModeToggle.tsx
`````typescript
 1: import * as React from "react"
 2: import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react"
 3: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
 4: 
 5: export function ModeToggle() {
 6:     const [theme, setThemeState] = React.useState<"theme-light" | "dark">("dark")
 7: 
 8:     React.useEffect(() => {
 9:         const isDarkMode = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
10:         if (!isDarkMode) {
11:             document.documentElement.classList.add("dark")
12:         }
13:         setThemeState(isDarkMode ? "dark" : "theme-light")
14:     }, [])
15: 
16:     React.useEffect(() => {
17:         const isDark = theme === "dark"
18:         document.documentElement.classList[isDark ? "add" : "remove"]("dark")
19:     }, [theme])
20: 
21:     return (
22:         <Button
23:             variant="ghost"
24:             size="icon"
25:             className="h-[50px] w-[50px]"
26:             onClick={() => setThemeState(theme === "dark" ? "theme-light" : "dark")}
27:             aria-label="Toggle theme"
28:         >
29:             <Sun className="h-6 w-6 rotate-0 scale-100 transition-all dark:-rotate-90 dark:scale-0" />
30:             <Moon className="absolute h-6 w-6 rotate-90 scale-0 transition-all dark:rotate-0 dark:scale-100" />
31:         </Button>
32:     )
33: }
`````

## File: src/components/TableOfContents.tsx
`````typescript
  1: import { useEffect, useState, type ReactElement } from "react";
  2: import { PanelRightClose, PanelRightOpen } from "lucide-react";
  3: 
  4: interface Heading {
  5:   depth: number;
  6:   text: string;
  7:   slug: string;
  8: }
  9: 
 10: interface HeadingNode extends Heading {
 11:   children: HeadingNode[];
 12: }
 13: 
 14: interface Props {
 15:   headings?: Heading[];
 16:   onVisibilityChange?: (isVisible: boolean) => void;
 17:   "client:load"?: boolean;
 18:   "client:visible"?: boolean;
 19:   "client:media"?: string;
 20:   "client:only"?: boolean;
 21:   "client:idle"?: boolean;
 22: }
 23: 
 24: export default function TableOfContents({ headings = [], onVisibilityChange }: Props): ReactElement | null {
 25:   const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string>("");
 26:   const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true);
 27: 
 28:   const toggleVisibility = () => {
 29:     const newVisibility = !isVisible;
 30:     setIsVisible(newVisibility);
 31:     onVisibilityChange?.(newVisibility);
 32:     (window as any).handleTocVisibility?.(newVisibility);
 33:   };
 34: 
 35:   useEffect(() => {
 36:     const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
 37:       (entries) => {
 38:         entries.forEach((entry) => {
 39:           if (entry.isIntersecting) {
 40:             setActiveId(entry.target.id);
 41:           }
 42:         });
 43:       },
 44:       { rootMargin: "0% 0% -80% 0%" }
 45:     );
 46: 
 47:     headings.forEach((heading) => {
 48:       const element = document.getElementById(heading.slug);
 49:       if (element) observer.observe(element);
 50:     });
 51: 
 52:     return () => {
 53:       headings.forEach((heading) => {
 54:         const element = document.getElementById(heading.slug);
 55:         if (element) observer.unobserve(element);
 56:       });
 57:     };
 58:   }, [headings]);
 59: 
 60:   const buildToc = (headings: Heading[]): HeadingNode[] => {
 61:     const toc: HeadingNode[] = [];
 62:     const parentHeadings = new Map<number, HeadingNode>();
 63: 
 64:     headings.forEach((heading) => {
 65:       const node: HeadingNode = { ...heading, children: [] };
 66: 
 67:       if (heading.depth === 2) {
 68:         toc.push(node);
 69:         parentHeadings.set(heading.depth, node);
 70:       } else {
 71:         const parentDepth = heading.depth - 1;
 72:         const parent = parentHeadings.get(parentDepth);
 73:         if (parent) {
 74:           parent.children.push(node);
 75:           parentHeadings.set(heading.depth, node);
 76:         }
 77:       }
 78:     });
 79: 
 80:     return toc;
 81:   };
 82: 
 83:   const renderTocItem = ({ text, slug, children }: HeadingNode): ReactElement => {
 84:     const isActive = activeId === slug;
 85: 
 86:     return (
 87:       <li key={slug} className="my-2">
 88:         <a
 89:           href={`#${slug}`}
 90:           className={`block py-1.5 px-4 text-sm rounded-md transition-all duration-200 ${
 91:             isActive
 92:               ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary font-medium shadow-sm"
 93:               : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary hover:bg-muted/50"
 94:           }`}
 95:         >
 96:           {text}
 97:         </a>
 98:         {children.length > 0 && (
 99:           <ul className="pl-4 mt-2 border-l border-white/10">
100:             {children.map((child) => renderTocItem(child))}
101:           </ul>
102:         )}
103:       </li>
104:     );
105:   };
106: 
107:   const toc = buildToc(headings);
108: 
109:   if (headings.length === 0) return null;
110: 
111:   return (
112:     <nav aria-label="Table of Contents" className="relative">
113:       <button
114:         onClick={toggleVisibility}
115:         className="absolute -left-6 top-0 p-1.5 rounded-md bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
116:         aria-label={isVisible ? "Hide table of contents" : "Show table of contents"}
117:         title={isVisible ? "Hide sidebar" : "Show sidebar"}
118:       >
119:         {isVisible ? (
120:           <PanelRightClose className="h-4 w-4" />
121:         ) : (
122:           <PanelRightOpen className="h-4 w-4" />
123:         )}
124:       </button>
125:      <div className={`transition-all duration-200 overflow-hidden ${isVisible ? 'w-full opacity-100' : 'w-0 opacity-0'}`}>
126:        <div className={`${isVisible ? 'visible' : 'invisible'}`}>
127:          <div className="font-medium mb-4 text-sm px-4">On This Page</div>
128:          <ul className="space-y-2">
129:            {toc.map((heading) => renderTocItem(heading))}
130:          </ul>
131:        </div>
132:      </div>
133:     </nav>
134:   );
135: }
`````

`````
  1: ---
  2: // Theme.astro - Theme Initialization Component
  3: // @ts-nocheck - Astro directives are not recognized by TypeScript
  4: ---
  5: 
  6: <script is:inline>
  7:   function getThemePreference() {
  8:     if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' && localStorage.getItem('theme')) {
  9:       const stored = localStorage.getItem('theme');
 10:       if (['light', 'dark', 'high-contrast'].includes(stored)) {
 11:         return stored;
 12:       }
 13:     }
 14:     
 15:     // Check for system preference
 16:     if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
 17:       return 'dark';
 18:     }
 19:     
 20:     // Default to dark theme to match the image
 21:     return 'dark';
 22:   }
 23:   
 24:   function setTheme(theme) {
 25:     const root = document.documentElement;
 26:     
 27:     // Remove all theme classes
 28:     root.classList.remove('light', 'dark', 'high-contrast');
 29:     
 30:     // Add the selected theme class (except for light which is the default)
 31:     if (theme !== 'light') {
 32:       root.classList.add(theme);
 33:     }
 34:     
 35:     // Set data-theme attribute for CSS selectors
 36:     root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
 37:     
 38:     // Store in localStorage
 39:     localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
 40: 
 41:     // Dispatch event for React components
 42:     window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('theme-change', { detail: theme }));
 43:   }
 44: 
 45:   // Initialize theme
 46:   setTheme(getThemePreference());
 47: 
 48:   // Listen for system theme changes
 49:   window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
 50:     const currentTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
 51:     if (!currentTheme || currentTheme === 'system') {
 52:       setTheme(e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
 53:     }
 54:   });
 55: 
 56:   // Expose theme functions to window
 57:   window.setTheme = setTheme;
 58:   window.getThemePreference = getThemePreference;
 59:   
 60:   // Cycle to the next theme
 61:   window.cycleTheme = function() {
 62:     const currentTheme = getThemePreference();
 63:     
 64:     switch (currentTheme) {
 65:       case 'light':
 66:         setTheme('dark');
 67:         break;
 68:       case 'dark':
 69:         setTheme('high-contrast');
 70:         break;
 71:       case 'high-contrast':
 72:         setTheme('light');
 73:         break;
 74:       default:
 75:         setTheme('dark');
 76:     }
 77:   };
 78: 
 79:   // Listen for theme changes from React components
 80:   document.addEventListener('set-theme', (e) => {
 81:     if (e.detail && typeof e.detail === 'string') {
 82:       setTheme(e.detail);
 83:     }
 84:   });
 85: </script>
 86: 
 87: <style>
 88:   /* Initialization styles to prevent flash */
 89:   :root {
 90:     color-scheme: dark;
 91:   }
 92: 
 93:   :root.light, :root[data-theme="light"] {
 94:     color-scheme: light;
 95:   }
 96: 
 97:   :root.dark, :root[data-theme="dark"] {
 98:     color-scheme: dark;
 99:   }
100: 
101:   :root.high-contrast, :root[data-theme="high-contrast"] {
102:     color-scheme: dark;

 23:   useEffect(() => {
 24:     const root = window.document.documentElement
 25:     root.classList.remove('light', 'dark', 'high-contrast')
 26: 
 27:     if (theme === 'system') {
 28:       const systemTheme = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
 29:         ? 'dark'
 30:         : 'light'
 31:       root.classList.add(systemTheme)
 32:       root.setAttribute('data-theme', systemTheme)
 33:     } else {
 34:       root.classList.add(theme)
 35:       root.setAttribute('data-theme', theme)
 36:     }
 37: 
 38: 
 39:     localStorage.setItem('theme', theme)
 40:   }, [theme])
 41: 
 42: 
 43:   useEffect(() => {
 44:     if (theme === 'system') {
 45:       const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')
 46: 
 47:       const handleChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
 48:         const root = window.document.documentElement
 49:         const systemTheme = e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light'
 50: 
 51:         root.classList.remove('light', 'dark', 'high-contrast')
 52:         root.classList.add(systemTheme)
 53:         root.setAttribute('data-theme', systemTheme)
 54:       }
 55: 
 56:       mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleChange)
 57:       return () => mediaQuery.removeEventListener('change', handleChange)
 58:     }
 59:   }, [theme])
 60: 
 61:   return (
 62:     <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
 63:       {children}
 64:     </ThemeContext.Provider>
 65:   )
 66: }
 67: 
 68: export function useTheme() {
 69:   const context = useContext(ThemeContext)
 70:   if (context === undefined) {
 71:     throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider')
 72:   }
 73:   return context
 74: }
 75: 
 76: 
 77: export function ThemeToggle() {
 78:   const { theme, setTheme } = useTheme()
 79: 
 80:   const toggleTheme = () => {
 81:     switch (theme) {
 82:       case 'light':
 83:         setTheme('dark')
 84:         break
 85:       case 'dark':
 86:         setTheme('high-contrast')
 87:         break
 88:       case 'high-contrast':
 89:         setTheme('light')
 90:         break
 91:       default:
 92:         setTheme('light')
 93:     }
 94:   }
 95: 
 96:   return (
 97:     <button
 98:       onClick={toggleTheme}
 99:       className="one-button-secondary p-2 rounded-full"
100:       aria-label="Toggle theme"
101:     >
102:       {theme === 'light' && (
103:         <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
104:           <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M20.354 15.354A9 9 0 018.646 3.646 9.003 9.003 0 0012 21a9.003 9.003 0 008.354-5.646z" />
105:         </svg>
106:       )}
107:       {theme === 'dark' && (
108:         <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
109:           <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M12 3v1m0 16v1m9-9h-1M4 12H3m15.364 6.364l-.707-.707M6.343 6.343l-.707-.707m12.728 0l-.707.707M6.343 17.657l-.707.707" />
110:         </svg>
111:       )}
112:       {theme === 'high-contrast' && (
113:         <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
114:           <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M9 3v2m6-2v2M9 19v2m6-2v2M5 9H3m2 6H3m18-6h-2m2 6h-2M7 19h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2zM9 9h6v6H9V9z" />
115:         </svg>
116:       )}
117:     </button>
118:   )
119: }
`````
