`````typescript
  1: import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
  2: import 'dotenv/config';
  3: import { openai } from "@ai-sdk/openai";
  4: import { anthropic } from "@ai-sdk/anthropic";
  5: import { mistral } from "@ai-sdk/mistral";
  6: import { openrouter } from '@openrouter/ai-sdk-provider';
  7: import { createEdgeRuntimeAPI } from "@assistant-ui/react/edge";
  8: import { type ChatConfig } from '@/schema/chat';
  9: import type { Message } from 'ai';
 10: 
 11: interface ChatRequest {
 12:   id: string;
 13:   messages: Message[];
 14:   config?: ChatConfig;
 15:   provider?: string;
 16:   model?: string;
 17:   apiEndpoint?: string;
 18:   temperature?: number;
 19:   maxTokens?: number;
 20:   systemPrompt?: string;
 21:   addSystemPrompt?: boolean;
 22:   addBusinessPrompt?: boolean;
 23:   content?: string;
 24:   attachedImageData?: string;
 25: }
 26: 
 27: interface ExtendedMessage extends Message {
 28:   role: 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant';
 29: }
 30: 
 31: const getProvider = (config: ChatRequest) => {
 32: 
 33:   const provider = config.config?.provider || config.provider || 'mistral';
 34:   const model = config.config?.model || config.model || 'mistral-large-latest';
 35: 
 36:   switch (provider) {
 37:     case 'anthropic':
 38:       if (!process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) {
 39:         throw new Error('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not configured');
 40:       }
 41:       return anthropic(model);
 42: 
 43:     case 'mistral':
 44:       if (!process.env.MISTRAL_API_KEY) {
 45:         throw new Error('MISTRAL_API_KEY not configured');
 46:       }
 47:       return mistral(model);
 48: 
 49:     case 'openrouter':
 50:       if (!process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY) {
 51:         throw new Error('OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured');
 52:       }
 53:       return openrouter(model);
 54: 
 55:     case 'openai':
 56:     default:
 57:       if (!process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY) {
 58:         throw new Error('OPENAI_API_KEY not configured');
 59:       }
 60:       return openai(model);
 61:   }
 62: };
 63: 
 64: 
 65: const loadSystemPrompt = async (addSystemPrompt: boolean = false) => {
 66:   if (!addSystemPrompt) return '';
 67:   try {
 68:     return "You are Agent ONE, an AI assistant focused on helping users with their tasks.";
 69:   } catch (error) {
 70:     console.error('Error loading system prompt:', error);
 71:     return '';
 72:   }
 73: };
 74: 
 75: // Function to load business prompts
 76: const loadBusinessPrompt = async (addBusinessPrompt: boolean = false) => {
 77:   if (!addBusinessPrompt) return '';
 78:   try {
 79:     return "You specialize in helping businesses with commercial applications, licensing, and enterprise solutions.";
 80:   } catch (error) {
 81:     console.error('Error loading business prompt:', error);
 82:     return '';
 83:   }
 84: };
 85: 
 86: // Process system prompt from various formats
 87: const processSystemPrompt = (systemPrompt: any): string => {
 88:   if (!systemPrompt) return '';
 89: 
 90:   if (typeof systemPrompt === 'string') {
 91:     return systemPrompt;
 92:   }
 93: 
 94:   if (Array.isArray(systemPrompt)) {
 95:     return systemPrompt.map(p => {
 96:       if (typeof p === 'string') return p;
 97:       if (p && typeof p === 'object' && p.text) return p.text;
 98:       return '';
 99:     }).filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
100:   }
101: 
102:   return '';
103: };
104: 
105: export const POST: APIRoute = async ({ request }) => {
106:   try {
107:     const requestData = await request.json() as ChatRequest;
108: 
109:     // Get the config object with proper typing
110:     const config = requestData.config || {} as ChatConfig;
111: 
112:     // Merge configuration from different sources, prioritizing direct properties over config object
113:     const provider = requestData.provider || config.provider || 'mistral';
114:     const model = requestData.model || config.model || 'mistral-large-latest';
115:     const temperature = requestData.temperature || config.temperature || 0.7;
116:     const maxTokens = requestData.maxTokens || config.maxTokens || 12000;
117: 
118: 
119:     const userSystemPrompt = processSystemPrompt(requestData.systemPrompt || config.systemPrompt || '');
120:     const addSystemPrompt = requestData.addSystemPrompt || config.addSystemPrompt || false;
121:     const addBusinessPrompt = requestData.addBusinessPrompt || config.addBusinessPrompt || false;
122: 
123:     // Get content settings
124:     const includeContent = config.includeContent !== undefined ? config.includeContent : true;
125: 
126:     // Get content if available
127:     const content = requestData.content || '';
128: 
129:     // Check environment variables early
130:     const envKey = `${provider.toUpperCase()}_API_KEY`;
131:     if (!process.env[envKey]) {
132:       throw new Error(`Missing ${envKey} in environment variables`);
133:     }
134: 
135:     // Load system and business prompts if needed
136:     const baseSystemPrompt = await loadSystemPrompt(addSystemPrompt);
137:     const businessPrompt = await loadBusinessPrompt(addBusinessPrompt);
138: 
139:     // Combine prompts
140:     let fullSystemPrompt = [baseSystemPrompt, businessPrompt, userSystemPrompt]
141:       .filter(Boolean)
142:       .join('\n\n');
143: 
144: 
145:     if (content && includeContent) {
146:       console.log('Adding content to system prompt');
147:       let processedContent = content;
148: 
149:       try {
150: 
151:         if (typeof content === 'string' && content.trim().startsWith('{')) {
152:           try {
153:             const parsed = JSON.parse(content);
154:             if (typeof parsed === 'object' && parsed !== null) {
155:               processedContent = parsed.value || parsed.content || parsed.body ||
156:                               parsed.text || JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2);
157:             }
158:           } catch (e) {
159:             console.log('Content is not valid JSON, using as-is');
160:           }
161:         }
162: 
163: 
164:         if (processedContent === '[object Object]') {
165:           processedContent = 'Error: Content could not be properly extracted';
166:         }
167: 
168: 
169:         fullSystemPrompt = `${fullSystemPrompt}\n\nPage Content:\n${processedContent}`;
170:       } catch (e) {
171:         console.error('Error processing content:', e);
172:         fullSystemPrompt = `${fullSystemPrompt}\n\nError: Could not process page content`;
173:       }
174:     }
175: 
176: 
177:     let messages: ExtendedMessage[] = [...requestData.messages] as ExtendedMessage[];
178:     if (fullSystemPrompt) {
179:       messages.unshift({
180:         id: 'system-1',
181:         role: 'system',
182:         content: fullSystemPrompt
183:       });
184:     }
185: 
186: 
187:     const formattedMessages = messages.map(msg => {
188:       if (Array.isArray(msg.content) && msg.content[0]?.type === 'text') {
189:         return msg;
190:       }
191:       return {
192:         ...msg,
193:         content: [{
194:           type: 'text' as const,
195:           text: typeof msg.content === 'string' ? msg.content : JSON.stringify(msg.content)
196:         }]
197:       };
198:     });
199: 
200: 
201:     if (requestData.attachedImageData) {
202:       console.log('Including image data in the request');
203:       formattedMessages.push({
204:         id: 'image-1',
205:         role: 'user',
206:         content: [{
207:           type: 'text',
208:           text: `Image URL: ${requestData.attachedImageData}`
209:         }]
210:       });
211:     }
212: 
213:     const handler = createEdgeRuntimeAPI({
214:       model: getProvider(requestData),
215:       temperature,
216:       maxTokens
217:     });
218: 
219:     const response = await handler.POST({
220:       ...request,
221:       json: async () => ({
222:         messages: formattedMessages,
223:         functions: [],
224:         function_call: null
225:       })
226:     });
227: 
228:     if (!response.ok) {
229:       throw new Error(`Edge runtime error: ${response.statusText}`);
230:     }
231: 
232:     return response;
233: 
234:   } catch (error) {
235:     const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
236:     console.error('Chat API error:', errorMessage);
237:     return new Response(
238:       JSON.stringify({
239:         error: errorMessage,
240:         timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
241:       }),
242:       {
243:         status: 500,
244:         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }
245:       }
246:     );
247:   }
248: };
`````

`````
  5: import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";

  8: import {

 10:   LayersIcon,
 11:   InfoCircledIcon,
 12:   LightningBoltIcon,
 13:   MagnifyingGlassIcon
 14: } from "@radix-ui/react-icons";
 15: import {
 16:   Grid2x2,
 17:   Grid3x3, Search,
 18:   BookText,
 19:   FileText,
 20:   List,
 21:   Table,
 22:   Grid,
 23:   Tag,
 24:   Folder,
 25:   FolderOpen
 26: } from "lucide-react";
 27: import { ChatConfigSchema } from '../../schema/chat';
 28: 
 29: // Type definitions
 30: type DocEntry = CollectionEntry<'docs'>;
 31: type DocFolder = Record<string, DocEntry[]>;
 32: 
 33: // Get view preference from URL or default to list view
 34: const viewMode = (Astro.url.searchParams.get("view") || "list") as
 35:     | "list"
 36:     | "compact"
 37:     | "grid1"
 38:     | "grid2"
 39:     | "grid3"
 40:     | "grid4";
 41: 
 42: // Get all docs entries
 43: const entries = (await getCollection("docs")) as DocEntry[];
 44: 
 45: // Get search query from URL
 46: const searchQuery = Astro.url.searchParams.get("search")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 47: 
 48: // Get tag filter from URL
 49: const tagFilter = Astro.url.searchParams.get("tag")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 50: 
 51: // Get folder filter from URL
 52: const folderFilter = Astro.url.searchParams.get("folder")?.toLowerCase() || '';
 53: 
 54: // Filter entries by search query, tag, or folder
 55: const filteredEntries = searchQuery || tagFilter || folderFilter
 56:   ? entries.filter((entry: DocEntry) => {
 57:       const title = entry.data.title?.toLowerCase() || '';
 58:       const description = entry.data.description?.toLowerCase() || '';
 59:       const section = entry.data.section?.toLowerCase() || '';
 60:       const tags = entry.data.tags?.map((t: string) => t.toLowerCase()) || [];
 61:       const folderPath = entry.slug.split('/')[0].toLowerCase();
 62:       
 63:       // If folder filter is present, it takes precedence
 64:       if (folderFilter) {
 65:         return folderPath === folderFilter;
 66:       }
 67:       
 68:       // If tag filter is present, it takes precedence over search
 69:       if (tagFilter) {
 70:         return tags.includes(tagFilter);
 71:       }
 72:       
 73:       // Otherwise use search query
 74:       return title.includes(searchQuery) || 
 75:              description.includes(searchQuery) || 
 76:              section.includes(searchQuery) ||
 77:              tags.some((tag: string) => tag.includes(searchQuery));
 78:     })
 79:   : entries;
 80: 
 81: // Group by folders (first level of path)
 82: const folders = filteredEntries.reduce((acc: DocFolder, entry: DocEntry) => {
 83:   // Extract the folder name from the slug (first part before slash, or 'root' if no slash)
 84:   const folderPath = entry.slug.includes('/') 
 85:     ? entry.slug.split('/')[0] 
 86:     : 'root';
 87:   
 88:   if (!acc[folderPath]) {
 89:     acc[folderPath] = [];
 90:   }
 91:   acc[folderPath].push(entry);
 92:   return acc;
 93: }, {});
 94: 
 95: // Sort folders alphabetically with 'root' at the top
 96: const orderedFolders = Object.entries(folders)
 97:   .sort(([a, _a]: [string, DocEntry[]], [b, _b]: [string, DocEntry[]]) => {
 98:     if (a === 'root') return -1;
 99:     if (b === 'root') return 1;
100:     return a.localeCompare(b);
101:   })
102:   .reduce((acc, [key, value]) => ({ ...acc, [key]: value }), {}) as Record<string, DocEntry[]>;
103: 
104: // Configure AI assistant for docs
105: const chatConfig = ChatConfigSchema.parse({
106:   systemPrompt: [{
107:     type: "text" as const,
108:     text: `You are a documentation expert for ONE framework, helping users navigate and understand the documentation. Focus on:
109: - Explaining documentation sections and their relationships
110: - Providing quick access to relevant documentation
111: - Clarifying technical concepts
112: - Suggesting next steps in the learning path`
113:   }],
114:   welcome: {
115:     message: "👋 Need help finding documentation? Ask me anything!",
116:     avatar: "/icon.svg",
117:     suggestions: [
118:       {
119:         label: "🚀 Quick Start",
120:         prompt: "How do I get started with ONE?"
121:       },
122:       {
123:         label: "📚 Learning Path",
124:         prompt: "What's the recommended learning path?"
125:       },
126:       {
127:         label: "💡 Features",
128:         prompt: "What are ONE's main features?"
129:       }
130:     ]
131:   }
132: });
133: 
134: // Get appropriate icon based on folder name
135: function getFolderIcon(folder: string) {
136:   switch (folder.toLowerCase()) {
137:     case 'getting-started':
138:       return RocketIcon;
139:     case 'core-concepts':
140:       return LayersIcon;
141:     case 'advanced':
142:     case 'ai-sdk':
143:       return LightningBoltIcon;
144:     case 'tutorials':
145:       return BookText;
146:     case 'troubleshooting':
147:       return InfoCircledIcon;
148:     default:
149:       return FolderOpen;
150:   }
151: }
152: 
153: // Format folder name for display
154: function formatFolderName(folder: string): string {
155:   if (folder === 'root') return 'Get Started ';
156:   
157:   // Replace hyphens with spaces and capitalize each word
158:   return folder
159:     .replace(/-/g, ' ')
160:     .split(' ')
161:     .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
162:     .join(' ');
163: }
164: 
165: // Function to create tag URL
166: function createTagUrl(tag: string): string {
167:   return `/docs?tag=${encodeURIComponent(tag)}`;
168: }
169: 
170: // Function to create folder URL
171: function createFolderUrl(folder: string): string {
172:   return `/docs?folder=${encodeURIComponent(folder)}`;
173: }
174: ---
175: 
176: <Layout
177:   title="Documentation - ONE Framework"
178:   description="Learn how to build AI-powered applications with ONE framework"
179:   chatConfig={chatConfig}
180:   rightPanelMode="quarter"
181: >
182:   <div class="max-w-full px-3 sm:px-4 pt-4 pb-2">
183:     {/* Header with Search and View Toggles */}
184:     <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-3 mb-4">
185:       <div>

187:           Documentation
188:         </h1>
189:         <p class="text-base text-muted-foreground mt-1">
190:           Everything you need to build intelligent applications
191:         </p>
192:       </div>

194:       <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 w-full md:w-auto">

206:           {folderFilter && <input type="hidden" name="folder" value={folderFilter} />}

209:         
210:         <div class="flex gap-1 bg-muted/50 p-0.5 rounded-lg">

213:             class={`p-2 rounded-md transition-all ${viewMode === "list" ? "bg-background shadow-sm" : "hover:bg-background/50"}`}
214:             aria-label="List view"
215:             title="List view"
216:           >
217:             <List className="w-4 h-4" />
218:           </a>
219:           <a
220:             href={`?view=compact${searchQuery ? `&search=${searchQuery}` : ''}${tagFilter ? `&tag=${tagFilter}` : ''}${folderFilter ? `&folder=${folderFilter}` : ''}`}
221:             class={`p-2 rounded-md transition-all ${viewMode === "compact" ? "bg-background shadow-sm" : "hover:bg-background/50"}`}
222:             aria-label="Compact view"
223:             title="Compact view"
224:           >
225:             <Table className="w-4 h-4" />
226:           </a>
227:           <a
228:             href={`?view=grid2${searchQuery ? `&search=${searchQuery}` : ''}${tagFilter ? `&tag=${tagFilter}` : ''}${folderFilter ? `&folder=${folderFilter}` : ''}`}
229:             class={`p-2 rounded-md transition-all ${viewMode === "grid2" ? "bg-background shadow-sm" : "hover:bg-background/50"}`}
230:             aria-label="Grid view with 2 columns"
231:             title="Grid view (2 columns)"
232:           >
233:             <Grid2x2 className="w-4 h-4" />
234:           </a>
235:           <a
236:             href={`?view=grid3${searchQuery ? `&search=${searchQuery}` : ''}${tagFilter ? `&tag=${tagFilter}` : ''}${folderFilter ? `&folder=${folderFilter}` : ''}`}
237:             class={`p-2 rounded-md transition-all ${viewMode === "grid3" ? "bg-background shadow-sm" : "hover:bg-background/50"}`}
238:             aria-label="Grid view with 3 columns"
239:             title="Grid view (3 columns)"
240:           >
241:             <Grid3x3 className="w-4 h-4" />
242:           </a>
243:           <a
244:             href={`?view=grid4${searchQuery ? `&search=${searchQuery}` : ''}${tagFilter ? `&tag=${tagFilter}` : ''}${folderFilter ? `&folder=${folderFilter}` : ''}`}
245:             class={`p-2 rounded-md transition-all ${viewMode === "grid4" ? "bg-background shadow-sm" : "hover:bg-background/50"}`}
246:             aria-label="Grid view with 4 columns"
247:             title="Grid view (4 columns)"
248:           >
249:             <Grid className="w-4 h-4" />
250:           </a>
251:         </div>
252:       </div>
253:     </div>
254: 
255:     {/* Filter Results */}
256:     {(searchQuery || tagFilter || folderFilter) && (
257:       <div class="mb-4 bg-primary/5 rounded-lg p-2 text-base">
258:         <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
259:           {searchQuery ? (
260:             <>
261:               <MagnifyingGlassIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
262:               <span>
263:                 Found {filteredEntries.length} result{filteredEntries.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} for <strong>"{searchQuery}"</strong>

268:               <Tag className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />

274:             <>
275:               <Folder className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
276:               <span>
277:                 Found {filteredEntries.length} document{filteredEntries.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} in folder <strong>"{formatFolderName(folderFilter)}"</strong>
278:               </span>
279:             </>
280:           )}
281:           <a href="/docs" class="ml-auto text-primary hover:underline text-base">Clear</a>
282:         </div>
283:       </div>

285: 
286:     {/* All Folders Navigation */}

305: 
306:     {/* Documentation Folders */}
307:     <div class="space-y-6">
308:       {(Object.entries(orderedFolders) as Array<[string, DocEntry[]]>).map(([folder, entries]) => entries.length > 0 && (

335:           {/* Grid 4 View - No descriptions, 4 columns */}

348:                           {entry.data.title}
349:                         </h3>
350:                       </div>
351:                     </a>
352:                   </Card>
353:                 ))}
354:             </div>

356: 
357:           {/* Compact View - Table-like format */}
358:           {viewMode === "compact" && (

367:                           <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />

369:                       </div>

371:                         <a href={`/docs/${entry.slug}`} class="group">

373:                             {entry.data.title}

375:                         </a>
376:                       </div>
377:                       <div class="p-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1 justify-end">
378:                         {entry.data.tags ? (

382:                                 <Tag className="w-3 h-3" />
383:                                 <span>{tag}</span>
384:                               </Badge>
385:                             </a>
386:                           ))
387:                         ) : (
388:                           <span class="text-base text-muted-foreground">-</span>
389:                         )}
390:                         {entry.data.tags && entry.data.tags.length > 3 && (
391:                           <span class="text-base text-muted-foreground">+{entry.data.tags.length - 3}</span>
392:                         )}
393:                       </div>
394:                     </div>
395:                   ))
396:                 }
397:               </div>
398:             </div>
399:           )}
400: 
401:           {/* Standard Grid Views */}
402:           {(viewMode === "grid2" || viewMode === "grid3") && (
403:             <div
404:               class={`grid gap-3 ${
405:                 viewMode === "grid3" 
406:                 ? "md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3" 
407:                 : "md:grid-cols-2"
408:               }`}
409:             >
410:               {entries
411:                 .sort((a: DocEntry, b: DocEntry) => (a.data.order || 0) - (b.data.order || 0))
412:                 .map((entry: DocEntry) => (
413:                   <Card className="h-full p-3 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-muted/50 hover:border-primary/30 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm">
414:                     <a href={`/docs/${entry.slug}`} class="group block no-underline">
415:                       <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
416:                         <div class="mt-0.5 p-1.5 rounded-md bg-muted/40 group-hover:bg-primary/10 transition-colors">
417:                           <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
418:                         </div>
419:                         <h3 class="text-base font-medium group-hover:text-primary transition-colors line-clamp-1">
420:                           {entry.data.title}
421:                         </h3>
422:                       </div>
423:                       <p class="text-base text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 mb-2 ml-8 group-hover:text-muted-foreground/80 transition-colors">
424:                         {entry.data.description}
425:                       </p>
426:                       <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 ml-8">
427:                         {entry.data.tags ? (
428:                           entry.data.tags.map((tag: string) => (
429:                             <a href={createTagUrl(tag)} class="no-underline">
430:                               <Badge className="text-base px-2 py-0.5 bg-primary/10 hover:bg-primary/20 text-primary border-none flex items-center gap-1">
431:                                 <Tag className="w-3 h-3" />
432:                                 <span>{tag}</span>
433:                               </Badge>
434:                             </a>
435:                           ))
436:                         ) : null}
437:                       </div>
438:                     </a>
439:                   </Card>
440:                 ))}
441:             </div>
442:           )}
443: 
444:           {/* List View - Optimized */}
445:           {viewMode === "list" && (
446:             <div class="space-y-1.5">
447:               {entries
448:                 .sort((a: DocEntry, b: DocEntry) => (a.data.order || 0) - (b.data.order || 0))
449:                 .map((entry: DocEntry) => (
450:                   <Card className="group hover:shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 border-muted/30 hover:border-primary/30 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm py-2 px-3">
451:                     <a href={`/docs/${entry.slug}`} class="no-underline block">
452:                       <div class="flex gap-2">
453:                         <div class="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 p-1.5 rounded-md bg-muted/30 group-hover:bg-primary/10 transition-colors h-fit">
454:                           <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors" />
455:                         </div>
456:                         <div class="min-w-0 flex flex-col gap-1 flex-grow">
457:                           <h3 class="text-base font-medium group-hover:text-primary transition-colors">
458:                             {entry.data.title}
459:                           </h3>
460:                           <p class="text-base text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">
461:                             {entry.data.description}
462:                           </p>
463:                           <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
464:                             {entry.data.tags ? (
465:                               entry.data.tags.slice(0, 4).map((tag: string) => (
466:                                 <a href={createTagUrl(tag)} class="no-underline">
467:                                   <Badge className="text-base px-2 py-0.5 bg-primary/10 hover:bg-primary/20 text-primary border-none flex items-center gap-1">
468:                                     <Tag className="w-3 h-3" />
469:                                     <span>{tag}</span>
470:                                   </Badge>
471:                                 </a>
472:                               ))
473:                             ) : null}
474:                             {entry.data.tags && entry.data.tags.length > 4 && (
475:                               <span class="text-base text-muted-foreground">+{entry.data.tags.length - 4}</span>
476:                             )}
477:                           </div>
478:                         </div>
479:                       </div>
480:                     </a>
481:                   </Card>
482:                 ))}
483:             </div>
484:           )}
485:         </div>
486:       ))}
487:     </div>
488: 
489:     {/* Empty State */}
490:     {filteredEntries.length === 0 && (
491:       <div class="text-center py-8 bg-muted/20 rounded-lg mt-4">
492:         <div class="max-w-md mx-auto">
493:           <FileText className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4 opacity-50" />
494:           <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold mb-2">
495:             {searchQuery 
496:               ? 'No matching documents found' 
497:               : tagFilter 
498:                 ? 'No documents with this tag' 
499:                 : folderFilter
500:                   ? 'No documents in this folder'
501:                   : 'No documentation found'}
502:           </h2>
503:           <p class="text-base text-muted-foreground">
504:             {searchQuery 
505:               ? `No documentation pages match your search for "${searchQuery}".` 
506:               : tagFilter
507:                 ? `No documentation pages found with tag "${tagFilter}".`
508:                 : folderFilter
509:                   ? `No documentation pages found in folder "${formatFolderName(folderFilter)}".`
510:                   : 'No documentation pages exist in the content collection.'}
511:           </p>
512:           {(searchQuery || tagFilter || folderFilter) && (
513:             <a href="/docs" class="inline-block mt-3 text-primary hover:underline text-base">
514:               View all documentation
515:             </a>
516:           )}
517:         </div>
518:       </div>
519:     )}
520:   </div>
521: </Layout>
522: 
523: <style>
524:   .card {
525:     transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;
526:   }
527:   .card:hover {
528:     transform: translateY(-1px);
529:   }
530:   
531:   /* Gradient background styling */
532:   :global(body) {
533:     background-image: 
534:       radial-gradient(at 100% 0%, hsla(var(--primary-hsl) / 0.15) 0px, transparent 50%),
535:       radial-gradient(at 0% 100%, hsla(var(--primary-hsl) / 0.1) 0px, transparent 50%);
536:     background-attachment: fixed;
537:   }
538: 
539:   /* Remove underlines from all links */
540:   a {
541:     text-decoration: none !important;
542:   }
543: 
544:   /* Tag hover styling */
545:   .badge:hover {
546:     transform: translateY(-1px);
547:     transition: all 0.2s ease;
548:   }
549: </style>
550: 
551: <script>
552:   // Handle search form submission
553:   document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
554:     const docSearchForm = document.querySelector('form');
555:     const docSearchInput = docSearchForm?.querySelector('input[type="search"]') as HTMLInputElement;
556:     const viewModeLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="?view="]');
557:     
558:     if (docSearchForm && docSearchInput) {
559:       // Add event listener for the form submission
560:       docSearchForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
561:         if (docSearchInput.value.trim() === '') {
562:           // If search is empty and we're already on the docs page with no query,
563:           // prevent the default action to avoid unnecessary page refresh
564:           const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
565:           if (currentUrl.pathname === '/docs' && !currentUrl.searchParams.has('search')) {
566:             e.preventDefault();
567:           }
568:         }
569:       });
570:       
571:       // Set focus on search input with a slight delay
572:       setTimeout(() => {
573:         if (docSearchInput.value) {
574:           // If there's a search value, place cursor at the end
575:           docSearchInput.setSelectionRange(docSearchInput.value.length, docSearchInput.value.length);
576:         }
577:       }, 100);
578:     }
579:     
580:     // Update view mode links to preserve search query and tag filter
581:     if (viewModeLinks.length > 0) {
582:       const searchParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
583:       const currentSearch = searchParams.get('search');
584:       const currentTag = searchParams.get('tag');
585:       const currentFolder = searchParams.get('folder');
586:       
587:       viewModeLinks.forEach(link => {
588:         const href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
589:         let newHref = href;
590:         
591:         if (currentSearch && !newHref.includes('search=')) {
592:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `search=${encodeURIComponent(currentSearch)}`;
593:         }
594:         
595:         if (currentTag && !newHref.includes('tag=')) {
596:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `tag=${encodeURIComponent(currentTag)}`;
597:         }
598:         
599:         if (currentFolder && !newHref.includes('folder=')) {
600:           newHref += (newHref.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + `folder=${encodeURIComponent(currentFolder)}`;
601:         }
602:         
603:         if (newHref !== href) {
604:           link.setAttribute('href', newHref);
605:         }
606:       });
607:     }
608:   });
609: </script>
`````

`````
 2: import Layout from "../layouts/Layout.astro";

 5: // Configure AI assistant for chat
 6: const chatConfig = ChatConfigSchema.parse({
`````

`````typescript
  1: import { cn } from '../lib/utils';
  2: import { Home, Folder } from 'lucide-react';
  3: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
  4: 
  5: export function Breadcrumbs() {
  6:   const [pathSegments, setPathSegments] = useState<string[]>([]);
  7:   const [isHome, setIsHome] = useState(false);
  8:   const [lastScrollY, setLastScrollY] = useState(0);
  9:   const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(true);
 10:   const [title, setTitle] = useState<string>('');
 11: 
 12:   useEffect(() => {
 13:     const updatePath = () => {
 14:       const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
 15:       setPathSegments(currentPath.split('/').filter(Boolean));
 16:       setIsHome(currentPath === '/');
 17: 
 18:       // Get the document title from meta
 19:       const titleElement = document.querySelector('title');
 20:       if (titleElement) {
 21:         setTitle(titleElement.textContent || '');
 22:       }
 23:     };
 24: 
 25:     // Initial path update
 26:     updatePath();
 27: 
 28:     // Listen for navigation events
 29:     window.addEventListener('popstate', updatePath);
 30: 
 31:     const handleClick = () => {
 32:       setTimeout(updatePath, 0);
 33:     };
 34:     document.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
 35: 
 36:     return () => {
 37:       window.removeEventListener('popstate', updatePath);
 38:       document.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
 39:     };
 40:   }, []);
 41: 
 42:   useEffect(() => {
 43:     const handleScroll = () => {
 44:       const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
 45:       setIsVisible(currentScrollY < lastScrollY || currentScrollY < 10);
 46:       setLastScrollY(currentScrollY);
 47:     };
 48: 
 49:     window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll, { passive: true });
 50:     return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
 51:   }, [lastScrollY]);
 52: 
 53:   interface Breadcrumb {
 54:     text: React.ReactNode;
 55:     href: string;
 56:     key?: string;
 57:     icon?: React.ReactNode;
 58:   }
 59: 
 60:   const breadcrumbs: Breadcrumb[] = [
 61:     { text: 'Home', href: '/', key: 'home', icon: <Home className="h-4 w-4" /> }
 62:   ];
 63: 
 64: 
 65:   if (pathSegments[0]) {
 66:     const section = pathSegments[0];
 67:     breadcrumbs.push({
 68:       text: section.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + section.slice(1),
 69:       href: `/${section}`,
 70:       key: section,
 71:       icon: <Folder className="h-4 w-4" />
 72:     });
 73:   }
 74: 
 75: 
 76:   for (let i = 1; i < pathSegments.length - 1; i++) {
 77:     const segment = pathSegments[i];
 78:     breadcrumbs.push({
 79:       key: segment,
 80:       text: segment
 81:         .split(/[-_.]/)
 82:         .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
 83:         .join(' '),
 84:       href: '/' + pathSegments.slice(0, i + 1).join('/'),
 85:       icon: <Folder className="h-4 w-4" />
 86:     });
 87:   }
 88: 
 89: 
 90:   const currentPage = pathSegments[pathSegments.length - 1];
 91:   if (currentPage && pathSegments.length > 0) {
 92: 
 93:     const displayText = title || currentPage
 94:       .split(/[-_.]/)
 95:       .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
 96:       .join(' ');
 97: 
 98:     breadcrumbs.push({
 99:       key: currentPage,
100:       text: displayText,
101:       href: '/' + pathSegments.join('/')
102:     });
103:   }
104: 
105: 
106:   if (isHome) return null;
107: 
108: 
109:   if (breadcrumbs.length <= 1) return null;
110: 
111:   return (
112:     <div className={cn(
113:       "h-12",
114:       "flex items-center",
115:       "bg-transparent",
116:       "transition-opacity duration-300",
117:       "pl-8",
118:       "pt-[9px]",
119:       isVisible ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
120:     )}>
121:       <nav
122:         aria-label="Breadcrumb"
123:         className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-muted-foreground"
124:       >
125:         {breadcrumbs.map((crumb, index) => (
126:           <div key={crumb.key || crumb.href} className="flex items-center">
127:             {index > 0 && (
128:               <span className="text-muted-foreground/50 mx-1.5">/</span>
129:             )}
130:             <a
131:               href={crumb.href}
132:               className={cn(
133:                 'hover:text-foreground transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5',
134:                 { 'text-foreground font-medium': index === breadcrumbs.length - 1 }
135:               )}
136:               aria-current={index === breadcrumbs.length - 1 ? 'page' : undefined}
137:             >
138:               {crumb.icon}
139:               <span>{crumb.text}</span>
140:             </a>
141:           </div>
142:         ))}
143:       </nav>
144:     </div>
145:   );
146: }
`````

`````
145:   // Smooth scroll for anchor links
146:   document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((element) => {
147:     const anchor = element as HTMLAnchorElement;
148:     anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e: Event) {
149:       e.preventDefault();
150:       const href = this.getAttribute('href');
151:       if (href) {
152:         const targetElement = document.querySelector(href);
153:         if (targetElement) {
154:           targetElement.scrollIntoView({
155:             behavior: 'smooth',
156:             block: 'start'
157:           });
158:           
159:           // Update URL without jumping
160:           history.pushState(null, '', href);
161: 
162:           // Update active state manually
163:           document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link => {
164:             link.classList.remove('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
165:           });
166:           this.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
167:         }
168:       }
169:     });
170:   });
171: 
172:   // Highlight current section in sidebar
173:   const observerOptions = {
174:     root: null,
175:     rootMargin: '-20% 0px -70% 0px', // Adjust the margins to make detection more accurate
176:     threshold: [0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1] // Multiple thresholds for better accuracy
177:   };
178: 
179:   const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
180:     entries.forEach(entry => {
181:       if (entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio > 0.6) { // Only trigger when section is more than 60% visible
182:         const id = entry.target.id;
183:         const sidebarLink = document.querySelector(`a[href="#${id}"]`);
184:         
185:         // Remove active class from all links
186:         document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link => {
187:           link.classList.remove('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
188:         });
189:         
190:         // Add active class to current link
191:         if (sidebarLink) {
192:           sidebarLink.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
193:         }
194:       }
195:     });
196:   }, observerOptions);
197: 
198:   // Wait for DOM to be fully loaded
199:   document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
200:     // Observe all sections
201:     const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
202:     sections.forEach(section => {
203:       observer.observe(section);
204:     });
205: 
206:     // Set initial active state based on URL hash or first section
207:     const hash = window.location.hash;
208:     if (hash) {
209:       const activeLink = document.querySelector(`a[href="${hash}"]`);
210:       if (activeLink) {
211:         activeLink.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
212:       }
213:     } else {
214:       const firstLink = document.querySelector('a[href^="#"]');
215:       if (firstLink) {
216:         firstLink.classList.add('bg-[#1E3A8A]');
217:       }
218:     }
219:   });
220: </script>
`````

`````markdown
 1: ---
 2: title: "Foundation"
 3: description: "Building the core pillars of your Ecom business context - Company, Market, and Customers"
 4: slug: "foundation"
 5: courseId: "elevate"
 6: order: 1
 7: status: "draft"
 8: tags: 
 9:   - "ecommerce"
10:   - "foundation"
11: image: "/images/foundation.jpg"
12: ---
13: 
14: ## Video Script
15: 
16: "Welcome to Module 0: Foundation! If the introduction got you excited about the possibilities, this is where the real work – and the real magic – begins.
17: 
18: Think of this Foundation module as pouring the concrete slab before you build your house. Everything else we do in this course – every AI prompt we use, every strategy we implement from the Elevate Framework – will rest directly on the clarity you build right here.
19: 
20: Why is this so crucial? Because AI, powerful as it is, needs **context**. To get specific, relevant, high-converting output from AI tools, you need to feed them specific, relevant, high-quality input about *your* unique business. Generic input leads to generic results.
21: 
22: In this module, we're going to systematically define the three core pillars of your Ecom business context:
23: *   **Your Company:** Getting crystal clear on your products, your unique selling proposition, your brand voice, and your goals.
24: *   **Your Market:** Understanding your competitors, your position within the market, and key trends affecting your store.
25: *   **Your Customers:** Diving deep into who your ideal buyers *really* are – their needs, desires, pains, and where to find them.
26: 
27: We'll be using the **Foundation Blueprint Worksheets** throughout this module (you'll find them available to download right near this lesson). Think of these worksheets as your structured guide to capturing all this essential information in one place. This completed Blueprint will become your go-to resource, the 'fuel' you'll use to customize the prompts in the AI Prompt Playbook in later modules.
28: 
29: Don't rush this stage. The time you invest here in gaining deep clarity will pay back tenfold in the speed and effectiveness of your AI implementation later on.
30: 
31: Ready to build that solid bedrock? Let's start with defining your Company Context."
`````

`````markdown
  1: ---
  2: title: "Hook"
  3: description: "Capturing attention where it counts - crafting compelling initial messages"
  4: slug: "hook"
  5: courseId: "elevate"
  6: order: 5

 12: ---
 13: 
 14: Okay, let's build out the content for **Module 1: HOOK** following the structure you provided and incorporating the revised framework (with FIND elements in Foundation).
 15: 
 16: ---
 17: 
 18: **Module 1: HOOK (Step 1) – Capturing Attention Where It Counts**
 19: 
 20: **(1. Intro | Module Introduction)**
 21: 
 22: *   **Format:** Text
 23: *   **Content:**
 24:     Welcome to Module 1, the first actionable step in the Elevate Ecommerce Framework: **HOOK**. In Module 0 (Foundation), you built your strategic bedrock – clarifying your Company Context, Market Awareness, and Customer Avatar, including the crucial "FIND" elements of identifying *where* your ideal prospects congregate and search.
 25:     Now, with that vital intelligence in hand, it's time to deploy it. The **objective of the HOOK step** is singular but critical: **to capture the attention of your defined ideal customer on the specific channels you prioritized**, using a compelling initial message ('hook') that stops them in their tracks and sparks genuine curiosity.
 26:     Getting the Hook right is essential. It's the gateway to the entire customer journey. A weak hook on the perfect channel still fails. A brilliant hook on the wrong channel never gets seen. This module focuses on crafting that initial, powerful message, leveraging AI for speed and options, but always guided by your Foundation strategy. Successfully capturing relevant attention here directly sets the stage for presenting your valuable **GIFT** in Module 2. Let's create some scroll-stopping hooks!
 27: 
 28: **(2. Video | Core Concept Explanation)**
 29: 
 30: *   **Format:** Primary Video Lesson, Support Text Summary
 31: *   **Video Script Outline:**
 32:     *   **(0:00-0:30) Intro & Recap:**
 33:         *   Greeting. Recap Module Objective: Craft attention-grabbing hooks for prioritized channels.
 34:         *   Emphasize dependence on **Foundation** Module outputs (Avatar pains/goals, FIND channel strategy, Brand Voice).
 35:         *   Goal: Show how to turn Foundation data + AI Playbook into effective hooks.
 36:     *   **(0:30-1:00) Why the Hook Matters:**
 37:         *   Explain the "scroll stop" challenge in noisy digital environments (social feeds, search results).
 38:         *   Connect hooks to Prospect Awareness Levels (briefly mention tailoring message).
 39:         *   Introduce hook types: Pain-Driven, Benefit/Dream-Driven, Intrigue/Curiosity-Driven, Authority/Proof-Driven.
 40:     *   **(1:00-2:00) DEMO: Crafting Hooks with AI Playbook (Example 1 - Pain):**
 41:         *   **Show:** Briefly display relevant parts of Foundation worksheet (Avatar pain points, target channel = Facebook Ads).
 42:         *   **Select Prompt:** Choose a specific Playbook prompt title for "Pain-Focused Ad Headlines" (from Prompts section below).
 43:         *   **Inject Context (Crucial):** Demonstrate copying the prompt structure and *clearly replacing placeholders* with Foundation data (specific pain language, audience description).
 44:         *   **Generate:** Run the prompt in chosen LLM (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini).
 45:         *   **Analyze:** Review generated headlines live. Discuss *why* some are strong (specificity, emotion) and others weak (generic). Show quick refinement/iteration if needed.
 46:     *   **(2:00-2:30) DEMO: Crafting Hooks with AI Playbook (Example 2 - Different Angle/Channel):**
 47:         *   **Select Prompt:** Choose a prompt for a different angle (e.g., Benefit) or channel (e.g., SEO Title/Content Hook).
 48:         *   **Repeat:** Inject context, generate, briefly analyze. Highlight adaptation for channel context (e.g., keyword focus for SEO).
 49:     *   **(2:30-2:45) The Hook's Job:**
 50:         *   Reiterate the hook's purpose is to capture attention and *lead to the GIFT*. The message needs to create a desire or highlight a problem the Gift starts to address.
 51:     *   **(2:45-3:00) Summary & Action:**
 52:         *   Recap process: Foundation -> Channel Strategy -> Prompt -> Inject Context -> Generate -> Refine -> Use.
 53:         *   Direct viewers to the Action Checklist and AI Prompts section for this module.
 54:         *   "Now, go craft *your* compelling hooks!"
 55: *   **Support Text:** Summarize key concepts: Hook importance, types of hooks, leveraging Foundation context in AI prompts, refinement necessity, connection to GIFT.
 56: 
 57: **(3. Grid | Step-Specific 3x3 Grid - HOOK Crafting)**
 58: 
 59: *   **Format:** Visual Graphic, Text Explanation
 60: *   **Content:**
 61: 
 62:     **HOOK GRID (Step 1): Designing Your Attention-Grabbing Message**
 63: 
 64:     *Purpose: To systematically design your initial hook message by connecting customer motivations (from Foundation) to a strategic angle and generating channel-specific outputs.*
 65: 
 66:     |                             | **1. Customer Driver Focus (Foundation Insight)**                                          | **2. Hook Angle & Core Message Strategy**                                                                                       | **3. Channel-Specific Output Examples (AI-Assisted)**                                                                                                          |
 67:     | :-------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
 68:     | **A. PAIN-FOCUSED**         | Target: Customer's Core Pains/Fears (e.g., "Low Conversions", "Fear of Wasting Ad Spend") | Angle: Agitate the specific pain, use empathy, highlight consequences. Message: "You're struggling with [Pain], and it's costing you..." | AI Output Ideas: "Shopify Conversion Rate Stuck Below 2%?", "Stop Burning Cash on Facebook Ads That Don't Convert." (Facebook Ad Headlines)                       |
 69:     | **B. BENEFIT/GOAL-FOCUSED** | Target: Customer's Tangible Goals/Deeper Dreams (e.g., "Predictable Sales", "Peace of Mind") | Angle: Promise the desired outcome, paint the vision, create aspiration. Message: "Imagine achieving [Goal] easily..."             | AI Output Ideas: "Unlock Predictable $10k+ Ecom Months", "The Simple Path to Scalable Sales & Less Stress" (Ad Headlines/Content Titles)                            |
 70:     | **C. INTRIGUE/UNIQUE-FOCUSED** | Target: Customer's Beliefs/Curiosity; Your Unique Mechanism; Market Frustrations        | Angle: Challenge assumptions, tease a secret, highlight your difference, use pattern interrupt. Message: "The surprising reason..." | AI Output Ideas: "Myth: You Need Complex Funnels...", "Why Your 'Optimized' Ads Still Fail...", "The ONE Prompt..." (Intrigue Hooks for Ads/Social/Content) |
 71: 
 72:     *   **How to Use:** 1) Select the primary **Customer Driver** (A) from your Foundation. 2) Define your strategic **Angle & Core Message** (B). 3) Use corresponding **AI Playbook prompts** (see section 5) to generate **Channel-Specific Output examples** (C) for the channels identified in Foundation/FIND.
 73: 
 74: **(4. Checklist | Actionable Task Checklist)**
 75: 
 76: *   **Format:** Text List, Downloadable Sheet
 77: *   **Content:**
 78:     *   ☐ **Review Foundation (FIND Strategy):** Confirm your prioritized target channels and corresponding customer segments/awareness stages identified in Module 0.
 79:     *   ☐ **Review Foundation (Avatar/Company):** Revisit key Customer Pains/Goals and your Core Value Prop/Unique Mechanism relevant to this hook.
 80:     *   ☐ **Select Primary Hook Angle:** Choose the main approach (Pain, Benefit, Intrigue) based on your strategy.
 81:     *   ☐ **Run AI Playbook Prompt (Angle 1):** Use the relevant prompt(s) from Section 5 below to generate initial hook assets for your chosen angle & primary channel. *Remember to inject your Foundation context.*
 82:     *   ☐ **Run AI Playbook Prompt (Angle 2 - Optional):** Generate variations using a secondary angle for testing.
 83:     *   ☐ **Review & Refine AI Outputs:** Evaluate generated hooks for relevance, clarity, brand voice, and channel fit. Edit as needed.
 84:     *   ☐ **Select Top 3-5 Hooks:** Choose the strongest contenders for initial testing/use.
 85:     *   ☐ **Draft Act 1 Creative Snippets:** Incorporate selected hooks into initial draft assets for your chosen channel(s):
 86:         *   *Ads:* Write corresponding Headlines and the first sentence/paragraph of body copy.
 87:         *   *Content:* Write the Title and opening paragraph incorporating the hook.
 88:         *   *Video:* Outline the first 5-15 seconds incorporating the hook.
 89:     *   ☐ **Output Check:** Ensure you have your selected Hooks list and draft Act 1 creative snippets ready.
 90: 
 91: **(5. Prompts | AI Prompt Playbook Section)**
 92: 
 93: *   **Format:** Text, Links/Embeds (Link to specific prompts in full Playbook if separate)
 94: *   **Content:**
 95:     *   *(Note: List Titles/Descriptions ONLY, as requested. Do not include full prompt text here).*
 96:     *   **Core HOOK Module Prompts (Refer to Full Playbook for complete text & usage):**
 97:         *   `Prompt H1: Pain-Focused Headlines (Ad/Social)` - Generates headlines directly addressing customer pains. *Requires: Customer Pains, Target Channel.*
 98:         *   `Prompt H2: Benefit/Outcome-Focused Headlines (Ad/Social)` - Generates headlines focused on achieving desired results. *Requires: Customer Goals/Dreams, Value Prop, Target Channel.*
 99:         *   `Prompt H3: Intrigue/Disruption Hooks (Ad/Social/Content)` - Generates curiosity-driven hooks challenging assumptions or teasing info. *Requires: Customer Beliefs, Unique Mechanism, Market Frustrations.*
100:         *   `Prompt H4: Ad Creative Opening Lines/Video Hooks` - Drafts the first few seconds/sentences for ads/videos based on a chosen angle. *Requires: Selected Hook Angle/Concept.*
101:         *   `Prompt H5: Content Title & Meta Description Hooks (SEO)` - Generates titles/descriptions optimized for search, incorporating hooks. *Requires: Target Keywords, Core Benefit/Problem.*
102:         *   `Prompt H6: Social Media Post Openers` - Drafts engaging first lines for organic social posts based on an angle. *Requires: Selected Hook Angle, Target Platform.*
103:     *   ***Reminder:*** *Always input your detailed Foundation context (Customer, Company, Market) into prompts for best results and refine AI output.*
104: 
105: **(6. Worksheet | Worksheet(s) / Template(s))**
106: 
107: *   **Format:** Downloadable PDF/Doc
108: *   **Content:**
109:     *   **HOOK Evaluation Matrix:** A simple table to list generated hooks and evaluate them based on criteria like Target Channel, Angle Type, Relevance (to Avatar/Pain), Clarity, Brand Voice Fit, and a selection checkbox. Helps objectively choose the best options.
110:     *   **Act 1 Creative Snippet Template:** A basic template with sections for Ad Platform/Content Type, Target Audience Segment, Chosen Hook Text, Draft Headline(s), Draft Opening Line(s)/Paragraph/Video Scene.
111: 
112: **(7. Examples | Output Definition & Examples)**
113: 
114: *   **Format:** Text, Visual Examples
115: *   **Content:**
116:     *   **Expected Outputs for This Module:**
117:         1.  A documented list of your selected **Top 3-5 Hooks**.
118:         2.  Draft **Act 1 Creative Snippets** for your primary chosen channel(s), incorporating these hooks (e.g., Ad Headlines + Opening Lines, Content Title + Intro, Video Opener Outline).
119:     *   **Example 1 (Pain Hook for Facebook Ad - High-Ticket Furniture):**
120:         *   *Selected Hook Text:* "Is Your $5k Sofa Listing Getting Clicks But No Sales?"
121:         *   *Draft Headline:* High-Ticket Ecom Conversions Stuck?
122:         *   *Draft Opening Line (Primary Text):* Seeing decent traffic to your premium product pages, but watching potential buyers vanish before checkout? It's a common frustration, especially for considered purchases...
123:     *   **Example 2 (Benefit Hook for Blog Post Title - SaaS):**
124:         *   *Selected Hook Text:* Unlock Predictable MRR Growth with [Your Unique Mechanism Angle]
125:         *   *Draft Title:* Unlock Predictable MRR Growth: The [Your Mechanism Name] Method
126:         *   *Draft Intro Paragraph:* Imagine knowing exactly what levers to pull each month to consistently grow your SaaS revenue, without relying on guesswork or complex funnels. Achieving predictable growth often feels elusive, but it starts with...
127: 
128: **(8. Implementation | Implementation Guidance ("Now What?"))**
129: 
130: *   **Format:** Text, Optional Short Video
131: *   **Content:**
132:     You've used the AI Playbook to generate powerful draft Hooks and initial creative elements. Now, let's put them to work:
133:     *   **For Ad Headlines:** Copy your refined headlines directly into the "Headline" fields in your chosen Ads platform (e.g., Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads). **Best Practice:** Create multiple ad variations testing your top 2-3 hooks against each other.
134:     *   **For Ad Opening Lines:** Use these as the *very first* sentence(s) of your ad's body copy (Primary Text/Description). Ensure they grab attention and lead smoothly into introducing the GIFT (which happens in the *next* module's assets).
135:     *   **For Content Titles/Intros:** Use the strongest hook as your main Title. Weave the opening line into your first paragraph to engage readers immediately.
136:     *   **For Video Hooks:** Use these lines and concepts for the first 3-15 seconds of your video script, potentially reinforced with on-screen text or dynamic visuals.
137:     *   **Crucial Link:** Remember, your Hooks must align visually and thematically with the assets you'll deploy alongside them (images/videos in ads) and logically lead the prospect towards the GIFT offer (Step 2).
138:     *   **Refine, Don't Just Use:** *Always* give the AI-generated drafts a final human polish to perfectly match your voice and intent before launching.
139: 
140: **(9. Transition | Module Summary & Transition)**
141: 
142: *   **Format:** Text
143: *   **Content:**
144:     Excellent work! In Module 1: HOOK, you've successfully translated your deep Foundation insights and FIND channel strategy into concrete, attention-grabbing initial messages. You've learned how to:
145:     *   Leverage customer motivations (Pains/Goals) for powerful hook angles.
146:     *   Use the AI Prompt Playbook to rapidly generate tailored hook options for specific channels.
147:     *   Refine AI outputs and draft initial "Act 1" creative assets.
148:     You now have the crucial first touchpoint designed to stop your ideal customer and spark their curiosity. With attention captured, you're perfectly prepared to move into **Module 2: GIFT**, where you'll design and offer a high-value lead magnet that converts that initial interest into tangible engagement. Let's build your irresistible Gift!
149: 
150: **(10. Book\_Chapter | Book Chapter Content Draft)**
151: 
152: *   **Format:** Text (Source Material for Book)
153: *   **Content:** *(Placeholder - This would contain the detailed, expanded prose version of all the concepts, strategies, examples, and guidance covered in points 1-9 above, written specifically for the book chapter covering Step 1: HOOK).*
`````

`````
  1: ---
  2: import Layout from "./Layout.astro";
  3: import { ChatConfigSchema, type Chat } from "../schema/chat";
  4: import CopyButton from "../components/CopyButton";
  5: 
  6: interface Props {
  7:   title: string;
  8:   description?: string;
  9:   children: any;
 10:   header?: boolean;
 11:   footer?: boolean;
 12:   chatConfig?: Chat;
 13:   rightPanelMode?: "hidden" | "full" | "half" | "quarter" | "floating" | "icon";
 14:   content?: string;
 15:   // For MDX files
 16:   Content?: any;
 17: }
 18: 
 19: const { title, description, header = true, footer = true, Content } = Astro.props;
 20: 
 21: // Get the raw content with fallbacks
 22: let rawContent = '';
 23: 
 24: try {
 25:   // First try: Direct content if provided
 26:   if (Astro.props.content && typeof Astro.props.content === 'string') {
 27:     rawContent = Astro.props.content;
 28:   }
 29:   
 30:   // Second try: MDX/Markdown Content component
 31:   if (!rawContent && Content) {
 32:     try {
 33:       if (Content.rawContent) {
 34:         rawContent = await Content.rawContent();
 35:       } else if (Content.render) {
 36:         const rendered = await Content.render();
 37:         rawContent = rendered.props.markdown;
 38:       }
 39:     } catch (error) {
 40:       console.error('[Content extraction warning]:', error);
 41:     }
 42:   }
 43:   
 44:   // Last try: Render default slot
 45:   if (!rawContent) {
 46:     try {
 47:       rawContent = await Astro.slots.render('default');
 48:     } catch (error) {
 49:       console.error('[Slot rendering warning]:', error);
 50:       rawContent = '';
 51:     }
 52:   }
 53: } catch (error) {
 54:   console.error('[Content extraction failed]:', error);
 55: }
`````

`````
  4: import { ChatConfigSchema } from '../../schema/chat';
  5: 
  6: // Get all book content
  7: const bookContent = await getCollection('book');
  8: 
  9: // Sort content by order
 10: const sortedContent = bookContent.sort((a: CollectionEntry<'book'>, b: CollectionEntry<'book'>) => {
 11:   const orderA = a.data.order || 0;
 12:   const orderB = b.data.order || 0;
 13:   return orderA - orderB;
 14: });
 15: 
 16: // Get current page
 17: const { slug } = Astro.params;
 18: const currentPage = bookContent.find((page: CollectionEntry<'book'>) => page.slug === slug);
 19: 
 20: // If page not found, redirect to 404
 21: if (!currentPage) {
 22:   return Astro.redirect('/404');
 23: }
 24: 
 25: // Find previous and next pages
 26: const currentIndex = sortedContent.findIndex((page: CollectionEntry<'book'>) => page.slug === slug);
 27: const prevPage = currentIndex > 0 ? sortedContent[currentIndex - 1] : null;
 28: const nextPage = currentIndex < sortedContent.length - 1 ? sortedContent[currentIndex + 1] : null;
 29: 
 30: // Get the content
 31: const { Content } = await currentPage.render();
 32: 
 33: // Configure AI assistant for the book chapter
`````

## File: src/pages/teacher.md
`````markdown
 1: Hi. I'm Anthony O'Connell. I help companies attract, convert and grow customers using the web and AI. I founded and built ONE. I will be your teacher.
 2: 
 3: I've been working as a web designer, engineer, marketer, and educator for 30 years already. I began crafting the web after I graduated with a degree in marketing from Portobello College (Ireland) in 1994.
 4: 
 5: Here's a few things I did first.
 6: 
 7: I setup Indigo, Ireland's first internet marketing agency. 
 8: I setup Ogilvy Interactive Research, Ireland's first Internet research company. 
 9: I developed the strategy to setup EuroMBA, Europe's first online MBA program.
10: I bought the first server that allowed secure transmission of credit cards over the internet. Before Netscape you couldn't do secure transactions on the web.
11: I was accepted into Instagram's chat early access program (before this I was building chatbots with Messenger).
12: I was one of the first users of GPT 3 (I got early access to their API), before this I was building AI applications with Google Dialogflow.
13: 
14: In 2009 I was asked to join the Education and Business Advisory Boards of the Lifeboat Foundation, a nonprofit nongovernmental organization. The Lifeboat Foundation is dedicated to ensuring that humanity safely adopts increasingly powerful technologies, including genetics/biotechnology, nanotechnology, and robotics/AI. I was really honoured to join other board members including inventor/futurist Ray Kurzweil, Director of Engineering at Google; Alex Wolszczan, discoverer of the first planets ever found outside our solar system; Ian Foster, "father of grid computing," Frank Wilczek, winner of the 2004 Nobel Prize in Physics; and Sir Clive W.J. Granger, winner of the 2003 Nobel Prize in Economics. I believe in freedom of speech, privacy, and open technology.
15: 
16: I have specialised in Internet strategy, marketing, ecommerce and education. 
17: 
18: I built and managed and market ecommerce websites for companies like Gemcal (Thailand) Wonderfully Diamonds (UK), Mid-century Online (UK) and The Vintage Hub (Ireland). 
19: 
20: I worked as an internet strategist for the EADA Business School (Spain), and TEFL (Ireland). I worked as a curriculum designer and teacher of animation at Saint Gabriel's College (Thailand). I set up & managed marketing & research companies for Ogilvy (Ireland) and iMarketing (Australia). I developed strategies for companies in a diverse range of industries from smart drugs e.g. Prymd Labs (US) to consumer products e.g. Unilever (US), to media e.g. The Government of Thailand.
21: 
22: My career has brought me to the intersection of marketing, education, and artificial intelligence. I lead the research and development of ONE's strategy, design, website, engineering, AI, marketing and education. My passion is for teaching - both kids and executives. My goal is to help you grow your skills and business with AI.
`````

## File: src/schema/chat.ts
`````typescript
  1: import { z } from 'zod';
  2: import fs from 'node:fs';
  3: import path from 'node:path';
  4: 
  5: 
  6: const ProviderSchema = z.enum(['openai', 'anthropic', 'mistral', 'openrouter'])
  7:   .default('openrouter');
  8: 
  9: const ContentPartSchema = z.object({
 10:   type: z.literal('text'),
 11:   text: z.string()
 12: });
 13: 
 14: const SystemPromptSchema = z.union([
 15:   z.string(),
 16:   z.array(ContentPartSchema)
 17: ]).default('I am Agent ONE. How can I help you today?');
 18: 
 19: const SuggestionSchema = z.union([
 20:   z.string(),
 21:   z.object({
 22:     label: z.string(),
 23:     prompt: z.string()
 24:   })
 25: ]);
 26: 
 27: const MessageSchema = z.object({
 28:   id: z.string(),
 29:   content: z.string(),
 30:   role: z.enum(['user', 'assistant', 'system'])
 31: });
 32: 
 33: 
 34: const BaseChatSchema = z.object({
 35: 
 36:   layout: z.string().optional(),
 37:   title: z.string().optional(),
 38:   description: z.string().optional(),
 39:   keywords: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
 40:   categories: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
 41: 
 42: 
 43:   aiProvider: ProviderSchema.optional().default('openrouter'),
 44:   aiModel: z.string().optional().default('google/gemini-2.0-flash-001'),
 45:   apiEndpoint: z.string().url().optional().default('https://api.openai.com/v1'),
 46:   temperature: z.number().min(0).max(2).optional().default(0.7),
 47:   maxTokens: z.number().min(1).max(999999).optional().default(999999),
 48: 
 49: 
 50:   systemPrompt: SystemPromptSchema.optional(),
 51:   addSystemPrompt: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
 52:   addBusinessPrompt: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
 53: 
 54: 
 55:   welcomeMessage: z.string().optional()
 56:     .default('How can I help you today?'),
 57:   avatar: z.string().optional().default('/icon.svg'),
 58:   suggestions: z.array(SuggestionSchema).optional().default([]),
 59: 
 60: 
 61:   api: z.string().optional(),
 62:   apiKey: z.string().optional(),
 63:   runtime: z.enum(['edge', 'node']).optional().default('edge'),
 64:   includeContent: z.boolean().optional().default(true),
 65:   initialMessages: z.array(MessageSchema).optional()
 66: });
 67: 
 68: 
 69: export type ContentPart = z.infer<typeof ContentPartSchema>;
 70: export type Suggestion = z.infer<typeof SuggestionSchema>;
 71: export type Message = z.infer<typeof MessageSchema>;
 72: export type BaseChat = z.infer<typeof BaseChatSchema>;
 73: 
 74: 
 75: function loadPromptContent(filePath: string): string {
 76:   try {
 77:     return fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), filePath), 'utf-8');
 78:   } catch (error) {
 79:     console.warn(`Warning: Could not load prompt from ${filePath}`, error);
 80:     return '';
 81:   }
 82: }
 83: 
 84: // Function to combine prompts in order
 85: function combinePrompts(config: BaseChat): ContentPart[] {
 86:   const prompts: string[] = [];
 87: 
 88:   // Add system prompt (1.md) if enabled
 89:   if (config.addSystemPrompt) {
 90:     const systemPrompt = loadPromptContent('src/content/prompts/system.md');
 91:     if (systemPrompt) prompts.push(systemPrompt);
 92:   }
 93: 
 94: 
 95:   if (config.addBusinessPrompt) {
 96:     const businessPrompt = loadPromptContent('src/content/prompts/business.md');
 97:     if (businessPrompt) prompts.push(businessPrompt);
 98:   }
 99: 
100: 
101:   if (config.systemPrompt) {
102:     prompts.push(typeof config.systemPrompt === 'string'
103:       ? config.systemPrompt
104:       : config.systemPrompt.map((p: ContentPart) => p.text).join('\n\n')
105:     );
106:   }
107: 
108: 
109:   return prompts.map(text => ({
110:     type: 'text' as const,
111:     text: text.trim()
112:   }));
113: }
114: 
115: 
116: export const ChatSchema = BaseChatSchema.transform((config): Chat => ({
117:   ...config,
118:   provider: config.aiProvider || 'mistral',
119:   model: config.aiModel || 'mistral-large-latest',
120:   welcome: {
121:     message: config.welcomeMessage || 'How can I help you today?',
122:     avatar: config.avatar || '/icon.svg',
123:     suggestions: (config.suggestions || []).map(suggestion =>
124:       typeof suggestion === 'string'
125:         ? { label: suggestion, prompt: suggestion }
126:         : suggestion
127:     )
128:   },
129:   systemPrompt: combinePrompts(config)
130: }));
131: 
132: 
133: export interface Chat extends BaseChat {
134:   provider: string;
135:   model: string;
136:   welcome: {
137:     message: string;
138:     avatar: string;
139:     suggestions: Array<{ label: string; prompt: string; }>;
140:   };
141:   systemPrompt: ContentPart[];
142: }
143: 
144: 
145: export type ChatConfig = Chat;
146: 
147: 
148: export const ChatConfigSchema = ChatSchema;
149: 
150: 
151: export function normalizeConfig(config: Record<string, any>): Chat {
152:   return ChatSchema.parse(config || {});
153: }
154: 
155: export function createChat(overrides?: Partial<Chat>): Chat {
156:   return ChatSchema.parse(overrides || {});
157: }
158: 
159: export const createDefaultConfig = createChat;
`````

`````
199:     const isCoursePage = window.location.pathname === '/';
200:     if (isCoursePage) {
201:       document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
202:         anchor.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
203:           e.preventDefault();
204:           const targetId = anchor.getAttribute('href')?.substring(1);
205:           const targetElement = document.getElementById(targetId || '');
206:           
207:           if (targetElement) {
208:             targetElement.scrollIntoView({
209:               behavior: 'smooth',
210:               block: 'start'
211:             });
212:             
213:             // Update URL without triggering scroll
214:             history.pushState(null, '', `#${targetId}`);
215:           }
216:         });
217:       });
218:     }
219:   });
220: </script>
`````

`````
  2: import Layout from "../layouts/1.blank.astro";
  3: import { Chat as ChatComponent } from "@/components/Chat";
  4: import { normalizeConfig } from "@/schema/chat";
  5: 
  6: import type { ChatConfig } from "@/schema/chat"; // Import the type
  7: 
  8: interface Props {
  9:   frontmatter?: any; // Make frontmatter optional as config might come via chatConfig prop
 10:   chatConfig?: ChatConfig; // Add chatConfig prop
 11:   // For MDX files
 12:   Content?: any;
 13:   // Raw content
 14:   content?: string;
 15: }
 16: 
 17: // Destructure props, getting chatConfig directly if passed
 18: const { chatConfig: passedChatConfig, Content, content } = Astro.props;
 19: 
 20: // Get the raw content
 21: let rawContent = '';
 22: 
 23: try {
 24:   // First try: Direct content if provided
 25:   if (content && typeof content === 'string') {
 26:     rawContent = content;
 27:     console.log('[Direct content found]', {
 28:       length: content.length,
 29:       preview: content.substring(0, 100)
 30:     });
 31:   }
 32:   
 33:   // Second try: MDX/Markdown Content component
 34:   if (!rawContent && Content?.rawContent) {
 35:     rawContent = await Content.rawContent();
 36:     console.log('[Markdown content found]', {
 37:       length: rawContent.length,
 38:       preview: rawContent.substring(0, 100)
 39:     });
 40:   }
 41:   
 42:   // Last try: Render default slot
 43:   if (!rawContent) {
 44:     rawContent = await Astro.slots.render('default');
 45:     if (rawContent) {
 46:       console.log('[Slot content found]', {
 47:         length: rawContent.length,
 48:         preview: rawContent.substring(0, 100)
 49:       });
 50:     }
 51:   }
 52: } catch (error) {
 53:   console.error('[Content extraction failed]:', error);
 54: }
 55: 
 56: // Use the passed chatConfig prop directly, merging with potential rawContent
 57: const chatConfig = normalizeConfig({
 58:   ...(passedChatConfig || {}), // Use the passed config object
 59:   // If includeContent is true (based on the passed config), add the raw slot content
 60:   ...(passedChatConfig?.includeContent && rawContent ? { content: rawContent } : {})
 61: });
 62: 
 63: // Debug final state
 64: console.log('Content processing:', {
 65:   type: typeof rawContent,
 66:   rawLength: rawContent?.length || 0,
 67:   rawPreview: rawContent ? rawContent.substring(0, 100) : 'N/A',
 68:   includeContent: Boolean(passedChatConfig?.includeContent),
 69:   isJSON: typeof rawContent === 'string' && rawContent.startsWith('{'),
 70:   contentSettings: {
 71:     hasContent: Boolean(rawContent),
 72:     includeContent: Boolean(passedChatConfig?.includeContent)
 73:   }
 74: });
`````

`````
1880: // Smooth scroll function with proper TypeScript types
1881: document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach((anchor: Element) => {
1882:   anchor.addEventListener('click', function(this: HTMLAnchorElement, e: Event) {
1883:     e.preventDefault();
1884:     const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href') || '');
1885:     if (target) {
1886:       const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset;
1887:       const startPosition = window.pageYOffset;
1888:       const distance = targetPosition - startPosition;
1889:       const duration = 1500; // 1.5 seconds
1890:       let start: number | null = null;
1891: 
1892:       function animation(currentTime: number): void {
1893:         if (start === null) start = currentTime;
1894:         const timeElapsed = currentTime - start;
1895:         const progress = Math.min(timeElapsed / duration, 1);
1896:         
1897:         // Easing function for smoother animation
1898:         const ease = (t: number): number => 
1899:           t < .5 ? 4 * t * t * t : (t - 1) * (2 * t - 2) * (2 * t - 2) + 1;
1900:         
1901:         window.scrollTo(0, startPosition + distance * ease(progress));
1902:         
1903:         if (timeElapsed < duration) {
1904:           requestAnimationFrame(animation);
1905:         }
1906:       }
1907:       
1908:       requestAnimationFrame(animation);
1909:     }
1910:   });
1911: });
1912: </script>
`````

`````typescript
 15: }
 16: 
 17: interface CountdownTimerProps {

 20:   targetDate?: string;

 22:   originalPrice?: string;
 23: }
 24: 
 25: export function CountdownTimer({
 26:   className = '',
 27:   onComplete,
 28:   targetDate = '2025-05-01T00:00:00',
 29:   currentPrice = '999',
 30:   originalPrice = '1,999'
 31: }: CountdownTimerProps) {
 32:   const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState<TimeLeft>({ days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 });
 33:   const [isExpired, setIsExpired] = useState(false);
 34: 
 35:   useEffect(() => {
 36:     const calculateTimeLeft = () => {
 37:       try {
 38:         const now = new Date().getTime();
 39:         const target = new Date(targetDate).getTime();
 40:         const difference = target - now;
 41: 
 42: 
 43:         if (difference <= 0) {
 44:           setIsExpired(true);
 45:           setTimeLeft({ days: 0, hours: 0, minutes: 0, seconds: 0 });
 46:           if (onComplete) onComplete();
 47:           return;
 48:         }
 49: 
 50: 
 51:         const days = Math.floor(difference / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
 52:         const hours = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) / (1000 * 60 * 60));
 53:         const minutes = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60 * 60)) / (1000 * 60));
 54:         const seconds = Math.floor((difference % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
 55: 
 56:         setTimeLeft({ days, hours, minutes, seconds });
 57:       } catch (error) {
 58:         console.error('Error calculating time left:', error);
 59:       }
 60:     };
 61: 
 62: 
 63:     calculateTimeLeft();
 64:     const timer = setInterval(calculateTimeLeft, 1000);
 65: 
 66: 
 67:     return () => clearInterval(timer);
 68:   }, [targetDate, onComplete]);
`````
